reviewList.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I came here looking for a real deep tissue massage — not just a gentle rub-down — and Tuyet absolutely delivered.

She worked through every tight spot with real precision. You could tell she actually knows muscles — not just going through the motions, but feeling where the tension is and working it out properly. She used a warming balm (similar to Tiger Balm, with menthol) to heat up the muscles before going deeper, which made a huge difference. The combination of techniques she used was impressive — this was a proper therapeutic massage, not just a relaxation session.

The difference between this and your average salon massage is night and day. Most places just stroke your back and call it a massage. Here they actually work the muscles. My back, shoulders, and neck felt genuinely released by the end.

And a sweet bonus — they served yogurt at the end, which was a lovely little touch 🙂

Highly recommend Tuyet if you need serious muscle work done!

reviewList.text:
Really enjoyed our experience! We initially went to their first branch, but since there wasn’t a room available for 4 people, they kindly arranged a free Grab transfer for us to their second branch. Both receptionists were very accommodating and spoke excellent English.

At the second branch, Min was especially helpful. He made sure to understand our massage pressure and preferences and was very attentive throughout. Our therapists, Thuy (massage) and Lieu (hair spa), were professional and checked in with us to make sure everything was comfortable. In both branches, they immediately serve you refreshment drinks even without any booked services yet.

The only small suggestion for the massage would be to give a heads-up before turning or moving the client, rather than doing it unexpectedly.

We also loved the little touches afterward — calming tea, snacks, another serving of their delicious artichoke drink when we asked, and even bottled water to take home.

Overall, a wonderful experience! We’ll definitely visit again when we’re back in Da Nang and would happily recommend this spa to friends.

reviewList.text:
I had a wonderful experience at Furama Resort Danang, specifically at their V-Senses Wellness & Spa.

The booking and confirmation process was smooth and hassle-free. I decided to try their Hilot Therapy (Filipino massage), which is a new addition to their traditional Asian massage offerings, and I’m so glad I did.

An at the reception was incredibly warm and welcoming. She kindly suggested that I use the sauna and steam room before my treatment, which turned out to be a fantastic recommendation. It helped me fully unwind and prepared my body for the massage.

As for the Hilot Therapy, I absolutely loved it. Special thanks to my therapist, Trinh, for delivering one of the best massages I’ve ever had. Growing up, I wasn’t particularly fond of traditional “hilot” in the Philippines, as it’s often quite strong and typically done when you have a sprain, muscle strain, or are feeling unwell. However, the Hilot Therapy at V-Senses was a completely different experience — deeply relaxing yet still wonderfully therapeutic.

The heated banana leaf application was such a thoughtful and soothing touch, and the mild cupping truly elevated the entire treatment. I would highly recommend their Hilot Therapy to anyone with an active lifestyle who wants to relieve muscle tension while also calming the mind and body.

I will definitely be returning to V-Senses to try their other spa services and to simply relax in the beautifully ambient setting.
reviewList.author: Jyv Regis

reviewList.text:
I had a wonderful self-care weekend at V-Senses Spa, Furama Resort Danang, even though I wasn’t staying at the hotel. From the booking confirmation to my arrival, everything reflected a tranquil, classic atmosphere that immediately made me feel relaxed and welcomed.

The spa space was incredibly quiet and peaceful, and I was greeted with a lovely cup of tea. I appreciated the thoughtful consultation, where I could customize the massage intensity and choose my preferred essential oil—I highly recommend Eternal Forest, which is gentle and deeply calming.

The treatment began with a herbal foot soak, sea salt exfoliation, and soothing massage, accompanied by soft boat-bell sounds. The therapists were warm and attentive, making the experience feel truly restorative. I also enjoyed both the warm and cool saunas, which were a perfect ending.

Everything was beautifully done, and I left feeling completely relaxed and rejuvenated. It was absolutely worth it, and I didn’t want to leave at all. Highly recommended

reviewList.text:
Exceptional Spa Experience at Ara Spa

I recently enjoyed the Signature 120-Minute Package at Ara Spa, and it was one of the most relaxing experiences I’ve had in Vietnam.

The journey began with a 15-minute traditional Vietnamese herbal bath. The warm herbal water helped me unwind immediately and prepared my body for the treatment ahead. After that, I spent 15 minutes in the sauna, which was perfect for releasing tension and leaving me feeling refreshed.

The highlight of the experience was the 90-minute full-body massage. My therapist was highly skilled, attentive, and adjusted the pressure perfectly to my needs. Every muscle felt relieved, and I could feel the stress melting away throughout the session.

To complete the experience, Ara Spa served a traditional Vietnamese chicken soup after the treatment. It was warm, comforting, and exactly what my body needed after such a relaxing massage.

From the welcoming staff to the peaceful atmosphere and excellent service, every detail was thoughtfully prepared. I left feeling completely rejuvenated, refreshed, and energized.

I highly recommend Ara Spa to anyone looking for a premium wellness experience in Vietnam. I will definitely return on my next visit.

places.name: Skin Bar - Personalized Facial in Da Nang

reviewList.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

One of the best skincare experiences I’ve ever had!

From the moment we arrived, we felt genuinely welcomed. The team carefully analyzed our skin and created a personalized 90-minute treatment that included deep cleansing, facial massage, masks, and a relaxing massage for the neck, shoulders, and scalp.

The atmosphere is incredibly calming, with beautiful interiors, soothing music, and outstanding attention to every detail. The staff are professional, caring, and made us feel completely relaxed throughout the entire visit.

At the end, we received personalized skincare recommendations, and the experience was beautifully finished with delicious tea and sweets served in an elegant way.

If you’re looking for a luxury skincare experience in Da Nang, I highly recommend Skin Bar. I would definitely come back!

reviewList.text:
I had such a wonderful experience at Skin Bar in Da Nang. The studio itself is beautiful, stylish, and incredibly welcoming. From the moment I arrived, I felt that everything was designed with comfort and care in mind.
What I loved most was the personalized approach. Before the treatment, my skin was carefully assessed, and the specialist recommended the most suitable facial based on my skin’s condition. I chose the Calming Facial, and it was exactly what my sensitive, dehydrated skin needed.
Another detail that made the experience special was that you’re never just lying there waiting. While the mask and products are working, they treat you to relaxing head, neck, and shoulder massages, which makes the whole appointment feel like a true spa ritual rather than just a facial.
The owner is absolutely lovely, warm, and genuinely passionate about helping clients achieve healthier skin. Every step felt thoughtful and professional.
If you're looking for a facial in Da Nang that combines expertise, relaxation, and a personalized approach, I highly recommend Skin Bar. I left feeling refreshed, relaxed, and with my skin noticeably calmer and more hydrated.

reviewList.text:
I’m not usually one to write reviews because I have pretty intense ADHD and don’t usually have the patience for it 😅 but I got my hair done by Madam Thao yesterday and was so happy with the experience.

Their salon is completely vegan, so you can rest assured that all of the products they use don’t cause harm to animals. This was an absolutely huge selling point for me because I’ve been living in Da Nang for about eight months now, and it’s really hard to find salons that even understand the terms “vegan” and “cruelty-free,” much less are 100% vegan to begin with.

It’s so refreshing to be able to go somewhere and not have to ask a million questions just to make sure the beauty treatments I’m receiving don’t contribute to animal suffering.

They also finished my hair in under two hours, which I was really impressed by. That’s another thing that’s important to me because with my ADHD, I find it difficult to sit in a chair for an extended period of time. I’m also juggling a lot of projects, so I really appreciate it when a salon can provide high-quality services without taking all day.

There were two people working on my hair the entire time, and even though they didn’t speak much English, you could tell they were incredibly kind and wanted to do everything possible to make sure I was happy with the result.

This will definitely be my go-to salon from now on.

They also have a completely vegan restaurant right next door, so it’s super convenient to grab food and then get your hair done. That’s another thing I’ve struggled with in the past because I often forget to eat, then end up sitting in a salon chair for hours and hours. Then, by the time I’m finished, I’m exhausted and starving 😂

Honestly, what they’ve created by combining a vegan salon and vegan restaurant into one lifestyle hub is a genius idea, and I couldn’t be more grateful that Da Nang has something like this now.

Highly recommend for anyone looking for a vegan, cruelty-free salon experience in Da Nang. So so so grateful for them 🤍🤍

The whole experience was great!

Before I even come there, the owner was very responsive on messenger.

Location: location is fine, probably 5 mins away from the tail of the dragon bridge by motorbike. The sign board is a little bit small tho, but it is not really hard to find.

Prices: I feel like the prices are actually cheap compared to other places where the prices are double or even triple the amount. I only paid 250k vnd for the back massage and hair wash. 👍👍👍

The experience: The therapist was very accomodating and naking sure that the pressure is just right. I came in with back pain and she was able to focus in the parts that were really tensed. The last part of the massage was actually amazing when she streched my back and the cracking sounds were very satisfying. 🤣 After the massage was the shampoo, it was so relaxing that I actually fell asleep 😂. I have a really long hair but she was very patient especially when blow drying my hair. After, there was a small treat (yogurt) which I also enjoyed.

The only downside that I have noticed was that the place is quite small since the business is relatively new so it may be hard if you want to go as a couple or as a group. So, I hope more people can discover this place so she can get a bigger place next time!

Here’s the breakdown:

- Time. Exactly an hour and a half. Not a rushed 40-minute hack job, but not a three-hour marathon where your legs go numb either.
- Process. They work quietly and precisely. I didn't flinch once, even though my cuticles are pretty sensitive.
- The Result. My nails look like mine, just better. Thin, even, without that thick layer of gel that makes your fingers look like sausages.

It’s been two weeks now. The manicure survived deep cleaning without gloves and packing a suitcase. No chips, no lifting.

I won't call it 'pure magic' it's just good, solid work for a reasonable price. If you want results without drama or small talk, this place is a solid choice.

reviewList.text: Cô chủ và nv ở đây làm việc rất có tâm, gội kỹ, massage nhẹ nhàng không bị đau hay khó chịu chút nào. Thái độ phục vụ cực kỳ thân thiện và dễ thương, 10 điểm cho sự chu đáo!
reviewList.author: lâm trần

reviewList.text: The service was great, there was a lovely body masseuse, she did a really good job, everyone. I'll definitely come back if I have the chance.
reviewList.author: ha ngo

reviewList.text: This hair salon is great! My friends recommended it to me while I was traveling in Da Nang, and I loved it. The prices are reasonable, and the stylist washes my hair very cleanly and leaves it smooth. 100/10 🫰🥰
reviewList.author: Nguyễn Ly

reviewList.text: Good service and price is affordable! The owner is really nice
reviewList.author: Van Huynh

reviewList.text:
I just had a very impressive experience at a newly opened spa. The technicians were highly skilled, provided thorough consultations, and performed procedures gently and professionally. The space was clean, relaxing, and created a comfortable feeling from the moment I walked in.

What I appreciated most was that the spa uses reputable cosmeceutical products with clear origins, which gave me peace of mind. After the treatment, my skin felt healthier, softer, and noticeably more radiant.

If you're looking for a quality skincare service at a reasonable price, this is a place well worth trying. Wishing the spa continued success and growth!
reviewList.author: thảo trần

reviewList.text: This was my first time discovering this small spa. It's right in the city center. It's a small spa but it packs a punch. It's fully equipped. The owner does the treatments herself, one-on-one, so she's very careful and attentive. She gives detailed instructions on what treatments are best for my skin. Definitely worth coming back.
reviewList.author: Tu - EC23A Phan Thi Cam

reviewList.text: Good service, affordable prices, and high-quality cosmetics.
reviewList.author: Kiều Trương

reviewList.text: The owner takes such good care of the guests; the room is so relaxing, I slept in it and woke up with all my pimples gone!
reviewList.author: Trúc H.

reviewList.text: I liked the service, it was pretty relaxing and calm. Recommended 👍🏽
reviewList.author: Jose Miguel Dominici de la Rosa

reviewList.text: Great massage after traveling all day long, the ladies were so nice, they gave us cookies and water, I loved them. Such a great service !!❤️
reviewList.author: Vaneyri Romero

reviewList.text: Beautiful people. Lovely service and very clean
reviewList.author: Lisa M

reviewList.text: The mouse service was good, the staff were enthusiastic, I will bring them back next time.
reviewList.author: Giang Bùi

reviewList.text: My sister and I had a beautiful experience getting both Manicure and Pedicures. Lovely service.
reviewList.author: Jodie Murrin

reviewList.text: A very nice location to get a facial and a hair wash. Very clean and good service.
reviewList.author: Ayser G

reviewList.text: Very nice place. Clean and comfortable. I had a body massage and it helped me to relax. Nail color is nicely done as well. Will recommad this place! 👍
reviewList.author: peiying tsai

reviewList.text: Great place to enjoy a long relaxing facial and a hair wash. Just what you need to recharge.
reviewList.author: Cristina Prodan

reviewList.text:
They offer massage, nail, and facial services.
I was walking down the street and saw they had a massage spot, so I stopped in.
They explained everything to me in English and served me warm floral tea.
They even repaired the stones in my girlfriend's nails for free.
reviewList.author: Masa masa

places.name: Gạo Spa- Gội Đầu Dưỡng Sinh Đn

reviewList.text:
Do Spa is one of the top of my favorite spas when I come back to Da Nang, Vietnam.

- Good service and very nice. They are so kind and welcome.

- Reasonable price for foreigners.

Dospa is a good choice for customers.
reviewList.author: Gia Pham

reviewList.text: Very comfortable and relaxing massage. Masseuse was very strong and I fell asleep. Also uses hot towel to wipe off the oils after massage. Very refreshed
reviewList.author: Han Tran

reviewList.text: Good service and nice massage that having in Da Nang
reviewList.author: Trevor Tuhoy

reviewList.text: Good service and good experience
reviewList.author: 文仔

attribution.name: Gạo Spa- Gội Đầu Dưỡng Sinh Đn
Gạo Spa- Gội Đầu Dưỡng Sinh Đn

reviewList.text:
It’s been a week since I had my hair treated at EQ Hair, and I wanted to wait and see the results before leaving a review.

I had a Keratin treatment, while my daughter had a haircut and hair wash. I’ve washed my hair 3–4 times already, and I’m honestly surprised that it still feels just as smooth and soft as it did on the first day.

The result is even better than I expected. My hair looks healthier, smoother, and much easier to manage. My daughter was also very happy with her haircut.

Really impressed with the quality and the service at EQ Hair. Definitely beyond what I expected!
reviewList.author: Hauqhewh Sbwueheuhe

reviewList.text:
I’m honestly so surprised and incredibly happy with the result! 🥰 I never imagined that the messy, uneven color I had before could be transformed into such a beautiful tone.

The stylists here were so patient and meticulous. They spent almost 5 hours working on my hair, paying attention to every little detail to achieve this color. I truly appreciate their dedication, skill, and hard work.

Thank you so much for giving me a hair color that turned out even better than I expected. I absolutely love it! ❤️ I’ll definitely be coming back!
reviewList.author: Oabxodn Kwbdodh

reviewList.text:
Absolutely loved the place. I came to this salon for Japanese organic hair color. It went above and beyond my expectations
Two wonderful colorists was working on my hair simultaneously. Probably took no more than 15 minutes to finish coloring. The die itself did not have any smell that usually is present in all hair colors. Also the wait time before washing, was no more then 15 minutes instead of usual 45. After I was finished, my hair was softer than ever before after the hair die. It had been a month, it didn't fade a bit after the beach or hot yoga or numerous hair washes. And the price was totally reasonable! I am very impressed with this salon and quality of their work. I will definitely return and highly recommend it.
reviewList.author: Veronica Bloom

reviewList.text:
I had balayage done before coming to EQ Hair An Thuong, and this time I only wanted to fix and redesign the top/crown area so everything would look more balanced. I didn’t want to redo my whole head, especially because I was in a hurry and had to catch a flight.

The boss and the team at EQ Hair An Thuong handled everything really well. They understood exactly what I wanted and worked carefully to make the top blend naturally with my existing balayage. Even though I was short on time, they managed to finish everything beautifully and professionally.

The final result was much better than I expected, and I was also pleasantly surprised by the price — it was actually cheaper than I thought it would be. Really happy with the service and the result. Highly recommend EQ Hair An Thuong if you want professional hair work at a reasonable price!
reviewList.author: Vs Jdj

reviewList.text:
I had a wonderful experience at the salon.
The staff were very friendly and attentive, and they did a great job cutting my hair.
The place was clean and neat. I will definitely come back.
reviewList.author: Liễu Phạm

places.name: Gội đầu dưỡng sinh LanIvy - LanIvy Spa - Head Spa, Massage, Nails

reviewList.text: Very good massage. The lady also gave me ointment for mosquito bites.
reviewList.author: eddie duong

reviewList.text: The owner here is very dedicated. I got a hair wash and a neck, shoulder, and back massage, and afterwards I felt refreshed all day. I also tried other services and was very satisfied. I will definitely be a long-time customer 🥰
reviewList.author: HONG DIEN HUYNH

reviewList.text: The owner was enthusiastic and kind, and the hair wash was very relaxing. I'll definitely come back next time.
reviewList.author: Ly Đặng Trà

reviewList.text: The owner was very good at washing hair, and the prices were reasonable 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
reviewList.author: Vân Anh Mai

places.name: TIN spa gội đầu dưỡng sinh thư giản

reviewList.text: A fantastic experience, absolutely worthy of its 5-star rating. As soon as I stepped inside, I was impressed by the pleasant aroma of essential oils and the tranquil atmosphere, completely separate from the noise outside. The massage techniques of the staff were very professional, with just the right amount of pressure, helping to melt away all the tension in my body.
reviewList.author: Quỳnh Như Trần

reviewList.text: Excellent service, very thoughtfully done, I really liked it and will visit here more often.
reviewList.author: Từ Nhân

reviewList.text: Excellent quality, affordable prices. Enthusiastic and friendly staff.
reviewList.author: Hong Kieu

reviewList.text: It's a small shop, but the owner is skilled, dedicated, and enthusiastic.
reviewList.author: Chung Nguyễn Thị

reviewList.text: Nien Spa does a great job; after experiencing their service once, I'll definitely be coming back next time.
reviewList.author: Niên Trần

reviewList.text: This is my third time at the spa. Last time the treatment only lasted an hour. This time, I spent two hours, and it was a truly wonderful therapeutic massage experience. Before the treatment, my neck was stiff, but after two hours of full-body treatment, I felt much lighter. Nien Spa really makes you want to come back. See you in two weeks! Now I feel so much lighter. My neck pain is gone. As someone in the industry, I can feel the difference more deeply. I will recommend more of my colleagues to the spa for treatment. Thank you, staff member. Thanh and the owner of Nien Spa. The spa owner is also my first mentor who guided me into this spa profession.
reviewList.author: Phương Phạm

reviewList.text: The spa treatment service here is excellent, beyond amazing. The spa owner is very friendly and cheerful. I will visit regularly to support them.
reviewList.author: tat nam ngo

reviewList.text: Hmm... if your muscles are aching, give it a try. They are better than most physical therapists. As someone living in Da Nang, if you are looking for a place to get your body treated rather than a luxury spa, just go here.
reviewList.author: 김정호

places.name: Hoàng Yến Beauty Spa
places.address: 51C Dũng Sĩ Thanh Khê, Thanh Khê

reviewList.text: Very good experience, very kind and professional staff!!🫶🏼
reviewList.author: Valentine Nguyen

reviewList.text: The pimple extractor she uses is very skillful, the steps are very thorough, and she provides excellent customer care. I will definitely come back to book an appointment with her.
reviewList.author: ĐỨC DIỆP MINH

reviewList.text: I am very satisfied with the service, especially the enthusiastic and attentive staff.
reviewList.author: hing xuynh

reviewList.text: Excellent service, enthusiastic and attentive (especially Ms. Hoa, she did a great job).
reviewList.author: Khoa Đỗ Đăng

reviewList.text: I really enjoyed the atmosphere and service here; the prices are reasonable and it's super relaxing. Highly recommended for everyone after a stressful day at work!
reviewList.author: Yến Hoàng

reviewList.text: We walked in on a Monday morning during happy hour discount and were attended to right away. This visit didn’t disappoint at all. This place is reasonably priced, the ladies performed professional massage, the menu has plenty of options for massages (we chose the 60 minute aroma therapy). It was very pleasant environment. My favourite part was the tea and fruits before and after the session. The whole place is clean and smelled good with essential oils. We will come back again, probably every week for the rest of our trip in Da Nang.
reviewList.author: Fred Hollows

reviewList.text:
I had an amazing experience at Golden Lotus Oriental Organic Spa 1. The atmosphere was peaceful, clean, and beautifully designed. The staff were incredibly friendly, professional, and attentive throughout the entire treatment.

The massage was one of the best I’ve ever had — very relaxing and exactly what I needed after a long day of traveling. The herbal aroma, soothing music, and organic products made the experience even more special.

I left feeling completely refreshed and rejuvenated. Highly recommend this spa to anyone visiting Da Nang. I will definitely come back again! 🌿✨
reviewList.author: Natnicha Boonyakalin

reviewList.text: I went without an appointment, but they were able to fit me in an hour later, and since it was during happy hour, I got a discount. They gave me a thorough full-body massage, focusing especially on my shoulders and lower back. They checked in with me periodically to make sure the pressure wasn’t too strong. I felt completely relaxed. A light snack and drink were included at the beginning and end of the session. I’d love to come back the next time I’m in Da Nang. Thank you very much.
reviewList.author: Ma Ya

reviewList.text: Came here with my son to try their one hour shoulder neck head and foot massage based on good reviews and it didn’t disappoint us. The masseuses are skilled and the pressure is good. The aromatic ambiance is rejuvenating. We felt relaxed. Their service is great, highly recommended.
reviewList.author: Evelyn Lee

reviewList.text:
Great experience. Receptionist Ms. Ha is very helpful.

Opted for the 90 min aromatherapy body massage. Highly recommend this service and the place overall. Very hygienic, quality massage therapists, great pressure. We got therapist / masseuse number 480 & 691. Very good service by both. We gave a tip of VND 50,000 to each.

They have a welcome drink, and serve fresh mango & tea after the massage. Also have a shower to use after the massage.

Very safe place. They also have a locker to store your bag etc.

They accept card payments, with an extra charge of 3%. Service charge on the 90 minute massage is around VND 70,000. Do call and book an appointment as it gets quite busy here.

Highly recommend this place.
reviewList.author: Som B

places.name: ARI SPA
places.address: Lô 08 Phạm Văn Đồng, An Hải

reviewList.text: Best massage ever! Good service and very friendly staffs!! Thanks!
reviewList.author: Jisun Lee

reviewList.text: We had a wonderful experience with the 60-minute aroma spa! The quality was so good that the time just flew by. It was also great that our child could stay in the same room with us, which made the whole experience feel very safe and relaxing.
reviewList.author: PARK HYEONSIL

reviewList.text: Had an absolutely rejuvenating experience at Ari Spa in Da Nang! The ambiance is serene with a perfect blend of traditional Vietnamese elements and modern luxury. I went for the signature aromatherapy massage, and the therapist was incredibly skilled—left me feeling relaxed and energized. Highly recommend!
reviewList.author: Kwok Ho YAU (Henry)

reviewList.text: We got the 90 min session with hot rocks and oil. It was my first time getting the session but I was so satisfied! I would definitely recommend. Im not sure if I would get the rocks again but I will definitely do the oil again.
reviewList.author: Rose Lee

reviewList.text:
5 star massage at DaNang!

Clean and kind, nice place for the whole family 4-year-old child included.

Also they take care of the baggages during the waiting time
reviewList.author: Dongwon Shin

reviewList.text:
This was my second visit to this massage spa, and once again, it was an absolutely exceptional experience.

This time, I booked a 2 hour deep tissue massage, as I was looking for a firmer, more intense treatment. It was exactly what I wanted. My therapist was incredibly skilled, applying just the right amount of pressure while remaining gentle and caring throughout the entire session.

What impressed me the most was how attentive she was. She regularly checked to make sure the pressure was comfortable and that I was feeling okay, which made me feel completely at ease. Her professionalism, kindness, and genuine care made this one of the best massages I've ever had.

After two hours, I walked out feeling lighter, deeply relaxed, and completely at peace as if I was floating on a cloud. It was an unforgettable experience.

I also want to thank the entire staff for their warm welcome and kindness. Everyone is so friendly and makes you feel comfortable from the moment you arrive.

If you're in Da Nang, do yourself a favor and visit this place. I can't recommend it highly enough. I'll definitely be coming back again, and again and again ! 😅
reviewList.author: Walter Hacque

reviewList.text: My husband and I came here, on our son's recommendation, for a 90-minute massage each. I had the hot stone massage whereas, my husband had the gentle one. It was really relaxing, and we both felt really rejuvenated afterwards. We were served coconut cookies and a cold drink before the massage, and watermelon slices plus a cold drink at the end.  The front desk staff were really friendly and helpful, and the therapists did an amazing job. Totally recommend this place!
reviewList.author: Siew Chappell

reviewList.text: This is my new favorite massage location right now. If you like to suffer like I do, choose deep tissue massage. As someone is active in sport and gym, it feels sooo good! Staff is very caring and professional. They give you snack and drink before and after massage. Highly recommend!
reviewList.author: Tien Nguyen

reviewList.text:
Great soft body and facial therapy session today with Jang Mi spa today. Staffs have good english speaking skills and they try their best to accomodate your requirements/ requests. They were absolutely gentle to my suntanned skin. Definitely recommended!
PS: They do have 3% surcharge for the card payments. Cash and QR have no surcharges!
reviewList.author: Rose Malla

reviewList.text: Great service from start to finish. A cold drink and coconut crackers at the start, then onto the massage. They have a real focus on hygiene during the massage and in the entire place in general (including the toilet facilities). They used several hot towels during the massage, which gave the feeling of being in a hot spa. They gave us tea and a slice of water melon after the massage.
reviewList.author: James Lawson

places.name: Nguon Spa Da Nang - Nguồn Hoàng Kế Viêm
places.address: 26XW+XQ4, 81 Hoàng Kế Viêm, Ngũ Hành Sơn

reviewList.text:
I had a 90 minute massage scheduled with Anh BT with a focus on my neck, shoulders, and lower back. Anh BT did not disappoint. Her technique, her pressure, was excellent and throughout the massage she had great communication always being sure to check in to make sure I was ok.

I only received a massage although the spa does offer other services such as facials, scrubs, and hair treatments. Unfortunately my appointment was very last minute so it was the only service I was able to get.

Upon arrival you are greeted warmly by the staff and welcome with an iced tea and dates. The place looks very clean and the staff are very friendly and professional.

I highly recommend this place if you are in Da Nang!
reviewList.author: Alissa Fontanos

reviewList.text:
Everything was great!! We booked a 90-mins tull body massage, and we was impressed by the moment we arrived at the spa. The building is well-designed and beautifully decorated inside and out, giving the nature and calming vibe. The place is nice and clean too.

The staff was very polite and triendly, clearly guiding us through the process. Tranh BK was my therapist and she was very good! I'm from Thailand and I have chronic back & shoulders pain, so my expectations for massage is very high, but Tranh could meet my expectations. After the massage, I feel relief, relaxed, and satisfied.

They also have complimentary drinks & snacks both before and after the massage, and they're very well presented. More than that, I love that they give us a bag to put our jewelries in. This is the first place I have received this kind of service. I think it’s very nice.

Thank you all so much for your warm welcome and excellent service 🙏🏼🌸
reviewList.author: Wander Ping

reviewList.text:
I had such a wonderful experience at the spa. I booked a massage and a hair wash, and both were excellent.

Trang gave me one of the best massages I’ve had—she was professional, attentive, and knew exactly how to work out the tension without it ever feeling too painful.

Trinh did my hair wash, and it was incredibly relaxing. She was gentle, thorough, and made the whole experience feel so calming.

The spa was clean, welcoming, and the staff were friendly throughout. I left feeling completely refreshed and would definitely recommend this spa to anyone visiting Da Nang. Thank you, Trang and Trinh, for taking such great care of me!
reviewList.author: Rameez Mookadan

reviewList.text:
An Absolute Hidden Gem — Vy is INCREDIBLE!

I don't even know where to begin — Nguon Spa has completely ruined every other spa experience for me, and I mean that in the best possible way. From the moment I walked through the door, the atmosphere was calm, welcoming, and immediately put me at ease.
But the real star of this place? Vy. Hands down one of the most talented, professional, and thorough masseuses I have ever had the pleasure of booking with. She has an extraordinary gift — the kind of intuition that lets her find tension you didn't even know you were carrying. Every single muscle group was addressed with intentionality and care. She didn't rush a single moment, working methodically and thoughtfully from start to finish.
What sets Vy apart is her professionalism. She communicated throughout the session, checking pressure and making sure I was completely comfortable. You can tell she genuinely takes pride in her craft and truly cares about her clients' wellbeing — not just going through the motions. I left feeling like a completely new person.
The space itself is clean, peaceful, and beautifully maintained. Every detail of the experience felt intentional and elevated.
If you are in Da Nang and looking for an exceptional massage experience, do not walk — run to Nguon Spa and ask for Vy. You will not regret it for a single second. I am already planning my next visit!
reviewList.author: Brandon Lucido

reviewList.text:
We visited this spa for the first time and we both had the synchronized Nourishment Package.

It was an incredibly relaxing experience we had. Our massage therapists, “Le” and Yen BT,” both are friendly and a strong hands that really helped loosen up our muscles.
And also to all the staff in Nguon Spa thank you so much❤️❤️❤️

Highly recommended!
reviewList.author: Helen

attribution.name: Nguon Spa Da Nang - Nguồn Hoàng Kế Viêm
Nguon Spa Da Nang - Nguồn Hoàng Kế Viêm

reviewList.text: Absolutely delighted to be here. Before you go in, you will fill in a simple form to help them tailor their services for you. You can choose your own essential oil. I personally really recommend the blossom one. The staff are really friendly. The massage experience was relaxing, with soft music in the background. They have warm pads for your neck and different body parts. Their coconut biscuits are delicious. Overall, it is definitely a 5-star experience.
reviewList.author: 0v0 Tree

reviewList.text: My wife and I had a truly wonderful experience enjoying a couples massage here on our anniversary night. The four-hands massage was a novel and excellent experience for us, complemented by the very warm welcome from the staff and the exceptionally relaxing atmosphere. This has been one of the best massages I have ever received.
reviewList.author: Joren Refuerzo

reviewList.text: Nice ambience. friendly & attentive staff.  skilful and meticulous therapists with strong, slow strokes . calm massage. Nice dessert! Tho a bit more pricey than those along common streets! But Best so far! Especially the four hands! Don’t miss!
reviewList.author: Rick Yang

reviewList.text:
A real luxury experience, recommend 4 hand massage!! We love it so much that we came here twice during our 4 day stay in Da Nang.

They are very attentive. I had a little cough and they offered water during the session at a suitable time. If you are used to massages, I recommend heavier strength. Feels really good! The communication is extra smooth for their staffs speaks good English!
reviewList.author: Huang Sophia

reviewList.text: Thanks for high quality stuff and work! I would like to come back here again! It was so nice to visit this place ✨ it was my first experience of massage and i totally satisfied with the results! what’s more after massage you will get some yummy natural snacks 😍
reviewList.author: Dasha Tretyakova

reviewList.text:
Went to this spot as a solo female around 1pm on a Tuesday with no reservation. Just had to wait 15m! I got the 2 hour massage because I’ve been averaging 20k steps around Vietnam and really needed it, especially cuz I’m leaving tomorrow morning and going to be on a flight. Very pleasant and relaxing experience! Organized, not chaotic, peaceful, exactly what I needed. I would definitely come here again!

They were attentive to the form I filled out, place was very clean and safe! I especially liked that my massage was in a private room with private bathroom.
reviewList.author: Leah Acosta

reviewList.text: The massage is excellent! My massage lady is very professional and nice. Her skills and attitude are amazing. Shop is clean and smell extremely nice. Great spot to pass by for a relaxing evening!
reviewList.author: Guest

reviewList.text: We had a good experience last time, so we decided to come back for a second visit! The hot stone massage was really relaxing. We love it a lot!!
reviewList.author: Yasti Choi

reviewList.text: It’s really bad massage in my life. I won’t recommend to everyone to come. Otherwise, more victims will be like me to experience the horrible massage in your lifetime.
reviewList.author: Yin ki Lee

reviewList.text: Passed by this afternoon and was invited in by the staff wearing traditional Ao Dai. The reviews were spot on—the environment is great and the two-hour massage was excellent. Highly recommended if you are visiting Da Nang.
reviewList.author: WJ

reviewList.text:
[Mar 2026] Very good experience here!  More expensive than most others, but worth the value you get from start to finish.  They are very popular, so best to make a reservation before going down.

Polite, friendly and warm all round. You'll be ushered into a warmly decorated waiting area for a drink, snacks and a cold towel, where they will confirm the massage you want. Then there's a foot bath area before the massage. And post-massage, there's another rest area where tea and fruits are served. The decor in the pre- and post-massage areas are well thought out - the former is warmer and darker to quieten you, the latter is more open and brighter to lift your spirit and help you feel relaxed and go "ahhh..."

The masseur was good. I like a very strong massage and the masseur got the pressure right without any need to request any change. The pace of the strokes was smooth and slow. Oberall, a very therapeutic and relaxing session. 90mins went by very fast!
reviewList.author: peregrine

reviewList.text:
I had a hot stone massage and it was so relaxing.
The stones warmed up my body nicely, and the pressure was just right, firm but not too painful. The one hour went by so quickly because it felt so good.
The reception staff and massage therapist were all very kind and friendly, with lovely smiles. I also enjoyed the welcome drink and after-treatment drink.
I’m very happy with the experience and would love to come back again!
reviewList.author: Maho H

reviewList.text: Just went here with my hubby and had an amazing 60minutes feet massage. It was clean. The decor was nicely done and you end with yummy mangos and other treats. Everyone was really nice. We were lucky to be taken cared of day of without a wait. Will definitely come back and refer to friends and family.
reviewList.author: Lien

reviewList.text: An amazing experience at Golden Lotus! It’s a very busy spot, so definitely book a slot in advance, especially during the holidays. The service was fantastic and the therapists are incredibly skilled; we completely drifted off to sleep. The complimentary tea and fresh mango fruit served before and after were lovely touches. Will absolutely return on our next trip to Da Nang!
reviewList.author: Paige Pang

reviewList.text:
I chose the 60-minute Foot Massage, and it was exactly what my tired feet needed. The treatment was incredibly relaxing, and the last 15 minutes included a neck and shoulder massage, which made the whole experience even more enjoyable and soothing.

The staff were friendly, attentive, and professional throughout the visit. The atmosphere was calm, comfortable, and truly relaxing. I left feeling refreshed and rejuvenated.

Highly recommended if you're looking for a quality massage experience in Da Nang!
reviewList.author: Cao Huyen Thanh

reviewList.text:
One of the Most Relaxing Spas I Found in Da Nang

After days of exploring Da Nang, walking along the beach, and climbing mountains, sometimes your body just asks for one thing…

A good massage.

That’s exactly what I found at Sum Spa Da Nang.

From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere changes.

🌿 Soft lighting
🎵 Calm music
🌸 Pleasant aromas
😊 Friendly staff who make you feel welcome from the start

Whether you’re looking for a traditional Vietnamese massage, a relaxing oil massage, or simply a quiet place to unwind, Sum Spa offers the perfect break from the city’s busy streets.

After an hour, you’ll probably walk out feeling lighter, more relaxed, and ready for another day of exploring.
reviewList.author: Resulizm B.

reviewList.text: Great massage shop with a variety and massage style options (ie. Aromatherapy, Thai, Swedish, etc). They were offering 50% off on most of their services, which was incredible value. I opted for a 2hr massage and it worked out to be less than 500,000 vnd ($18USD). Staff was friendly and accommodating even though I didn't have a reservation booked. Front desk girl that assisted me was able to speak English and was very friendly and helpful. The room was very clean and comfortable, despite it being almost 40 degrees outside. The massage therapist was very good and 10mins into the session, another staff member came in to make sure I was happy with everything so far. Overall great experience and customer service. Highly recommended.
reviewList.author: D Y

reviewList.text: My wife had the head & shoulders massage while I had the foot reflexology. It was very nice. We were served lemon juice upon entering, then after the massages we had fresh fruits & warm ginger tea. They were all proffesionals & did the massages very nice. Will definitely come again next time.
reviewList.author: MUHAMAD AZRI ZAINAL AZMAN

reviewList.text: We had an amazing experience at Sum Spa Da Nang. Super relaxing atmosphere, professional staff, and one of the best massages I've had during my trip. Had a 60 min aroma therapy massage here and it was excellent. Clean place, calming vibe, and the therapists were very skilled. Perfect after a long day of travel. Totally worth it!
reviewList.author: Devendra Patil

reviewList.text: I’m writing this review while having this post massage snack I was given. Sum spa was the best choice I could have made for massage in da Nang. reviewList.text:
My mom and I visited PAM Spa during our trip to Da Nang, and it was truly one of the highlights of our vacation.

The massage was absolutely amazing. After several days of traveling and walking around the city, we both had sore muscles and felt quite tired. The therapists were very professional and skilled, providing the perfect pressure and paying close attention to our comfort throughout the session. We left feeling completely refreshed, relaxed, and energized.

The spa itself was clean, peaceful, and beautifully maintained. The staff were welcoming, friendly, and attentive from the moment we arrived. Their hospitality made the experience even more enjoyable. My mom especially loved the massage and said it was one of the best she has ever had.

What made this visit even more special was being able to enjoy such a relaxing experience together with my mother. It became one of our favorite memories from Da Nang.
I highly recommend PAM Spa to anyone looking for a high-quality massage and exceptional service. We will definitely return the next time we visit Da Nang. Thank you to the wonderful team at PAM Spa for such a fantastic experience!
reviewList.author: 김지은

reviewList.text: I had a two-hour massage yesterday that was already amazing—I didn’t think it could get any better. But trying a four-hand massage for the first time completely transformed the experience. It felt endless, like waves of relaxation flowing without pause. Pam Spa was welcoming and attentive, from the moment I walked in to the care after the session. The therapists’ movements, while not perfectly that felt wonderful. The pressure stayed consistent throughout, which made it even more enjoyable. Honestly, it’s going to be tough going back to the usual foot massages we get in the US after this.
reviewList.author: BK

reviewList.text:
I had an amazing experience at this spa and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a professional and relaxing massage.

From the moment I walked in, the service was exceptional. The receptionist was incredibly welcoming, friendly, and professional. She took the time to answer all of my questions about the spa and made me feel comfortable right away. Before the massage, I was asked to complete a short form indicating which areas of my body I wanted the therapist to focus on and whether I had any preferences for the massage. I really appreciated this thoughtful and personalised approach.

The massage therapist was outstanding. She was highly professional, clearly very experienced, and her massage techniques were excellent. She knew exactly how to work on the right pressure points and adjusted the pressure immediately whenever I requested. The entire massage was both relaxing and therapeutic, and I left feeling completely refreshed.

Another lovely touch was being served jasmine tea and delicious snacks both before and after the massage. It really added to the overall experience and made the visit feel even more special.

Overall, this was a five-star experience from beginning to end. The excellent customer service, skilled therapist, and thoughtful attention to detail made this one of the best massage experiences I've had. I'll definitely be returning the next time I'm in the area!
reviewList.author: Shashank Tamgadge

reviewList.text: If you’re visiting Da Nang, run to this place! This is hands down the #1 massage in Da Nang. We had an amazing experience from start to finish. We will definitely come back. Highly recommended!

reviewList.text:
I saw a review from a TikToker named Ducy (“Đu Xi Ưa Đi”) who experienced services at Chua Spa, so I trusted the place and decided to come here. I called in advance to make a reservation before arriving.

When I got to Chua Spa, the receptionist recommended a 90-minute massage package for 420k. I also asked about the sauna services, both dry and steam sauna, and the receptionist told me they had everything, including a herbal foot soak service. However, the receptionists said I would do the massage first and then use the sauna afterward.

I found that a bit strange because I’ve been to many massage places before, and usually customers shower first, then use the steam sauna and herbal foot soak, followed by the dry sauna, and finally the massage. Still, I happily agreed to follow the staff’s instructions.

As for the massage therapist’s skills, I honestly was not very impressed. The staff seemed quite young and inexperienced, so their techniques were not very professional yet.

About 10 minutes into my massage, another guest entered my room with a child around 3–4 years old. The child kept screaming nonstop, so I asked the staff to move me to another room.

After the oil and hot stone massage, I was taken to the steam sauna. The sauna room was very small, nothing like what I had seen in the reviews. I waited a long time, and the steam only started coming out after around 10 minutes. There was also no foot soak basin.

After finishing the steam sauna, I wanted to use the dry sauna as well, but when I asked, the staff told me that the women’s area did not have a dry sauna or a foot soak area. Apparently, only the men’s section had the full facilities.

So why didn’t they tell me that from the beginning? When I looked at the menu, men and women were charged the same price.

I then asked where I was supposed to do the herbal foot soak. The staff awkwardly brought out a basin of water for me in the changing room, where many guests were constantly walking in and out to change clothes and store their belongings. It felt extremely inconvenient and uncomfortable.

I spent money expecting to relax, but the experience was honestly very disappointing.

reviewList.text:
I recently had the chance to experience a traditional Vietnamese hair wash at IKIGAI SPA CENTER, and it was absolutely amazing.
From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere felt calm and relaxing. The staff were very welcoming and professional, making me feel comfortable right away. The hair washing service was much more than just a simple wash — it felt like a full relaxation treatment.
They started with a gentle scalp massage that helped relieve all my stress. The techniques were slow, rhythmic, and incredibly soothing. Then came the shampooing, which was done very carefully and thoroughly, followed by a neck and shoulder massage that made the whole experience even better.
What I loved most was how attentive they were to every detail. The warm water, the soft movements, and the peaceful environment made it feel like a mini spa retreat.
After the wash, my hair felt super clean, soft, and refreshed. I also felt mentally relaxed and recharged.
If you are visiting Vietnam, I highly recommend trying a Vietnamese hair wash, especially at IKIGAI SPA CENTER. It’s not just about clean hair — it’s a unique and relaxing experience you shouldn’t miss 🥰🥰🥰

reviewList.text: Wow. Just randomly found this place, MAYA Spa, walking back from a different massage place that did not meet online expectations. They are the real deal. Had Anh as a therapist and got aroma massage 60min. Asked for firm pressure.and that was definitely what I got. No skimping on force for these tight muscles or on time. Included hand, head and foot massage as well as rub down to the rest of the body, some Thai-style stretching, etc. There was dry heat with beanbags of sorts before the stretching and a scrub down after the oil. You get tea and a cool towel before the foot bath and a delicious mango yogurt and watermelon after the hour of services -- all for 360K! 5 stars! I will be coming back and bringing the rest of my crew before we leave Da Nang 😊
reviewList.author: Kristen U

reviewList.text: Stumbled upon this place while passing by and later found it on Google with 2,000+ reviews, so I decided to give it a try. It was my first bamboo massage, and I was pleasantly surprised by the warm bamboo sticks and the eye mask provided during the treatment. The therapist was attentive, and the session was very relaxing. I also appreciated the thoughtful touches, from the welcome drink and refreshing wipes to the complimentary mango yogurt and fresh fruits after the massage. My only suggestion would be to add some soft background music in the massage room. Overall, a great experience and well worth a visit! 🌿✨

reviewList.text: I had an excellent massage experience. The therapist was professional, friendly, and made me feel comfortable from the moment I arrived. The massage was relaxing while also targeting the areas that needed attention, and I left feeling refreshed and completely rejuvenated. The facilities were clean, peaceful, and welcoming, creating the perfect atmosphere to unwind. I highly recommend this place and will definitely return on my next visit.
reviewList.author: Gareth Griffiths

reviewList.text: My review is way overdue, but it’s never too late to express gratitude for a marvelous experience. During my Da Nang visit in January, my friend and I dropped in at Maya Spa for a one-hour massage. Stepping into the beautifully appointed and spotlessly clean space was like entering a slice of heaven, with soft music enveloping us as we began our session with refreshments (and ended with more tasty treats). I requested a gentle full-body massage and the masseuse soon had me feeling peaceful and soothed. My thanks to the professional staff—friendly and skilled in their practice—and the owner, who was warm and thoughtful. Kudos to the interior designer for creating serenity in this space with precious attention to details. I know. I’m raving. But there aren’t enough words to share how enjoyable it was to have found Maya Spa—among the special highlights of my stay in Da Nang.

reviewList.text:
I came here for a 60-minute massage, which was very good and helped relieve many of the aches I get from carrying my baby son. The therapist did a great job, and physically I felt much better afterward.

However, I had to remove a star because of the pricing tactics. Customers are asked to pay in advance, but the bill already includes a 50k tip. Tipping should never be expected or automatically added in this way. It should remain a voluntary gesture from the customer.

I personally tip around 50k for most massages anyway, but adding it directly to the bill removes the goodwill behind the gesture. It also makes more sense to request or accept a tip after the massage, once good service has actually been provided.

I recently visited this place and was extremely disappointed with the overall service and experience.
First, the hair washing experience was even worse—the water temperature kept fluctuating between freezing cold and hot, but it was mostly icy cold for the majority of the time. To make matters worse, only after my hair was washed did I realize there was a male customer in the exact same room, separated only by a thin, flimsy curtain. The staff provided no advance notice or warning about this shared setup, which felt completely invasive and uncomfortable.
On top of that, the wait times were ridiculous. I was told the wait would be around 15 minutes, but ended up waiting well over 30 minutes with zero updates or explanations from the staff about the delay.
Unless you are actively looking to get your hair washed in freezing water with no privacy, I strongly suggest avoiding this place.

reviewList.text:
This is probably the best place in the world I’ve ever been to. From the very first step, you feel an atmosphere of comfort, calm, and true Balinese relaxation. The interior is thoughtfully designed down to the smallest detail: lush greenery, soft lighting, and natural materials — everything makes you feel like you’re far away from the noise of the city.

I was especially impressed by the attention to detail: the way tea and fruits are served feels like a special ritual rather than just a snack. After the massage, you feel completely recharged — both physically and emotionally.

The staff is very attentive and friendly, and the service is truly top-notch. You can tell they genuinely care about your comfort.

If you want to truly relax and experience more than just a massage, this place is definitely worth visiting. I would come back here without hesitation.

reviewList.author: Ая

reviewList.text: The best service and level of massage here. I lived in Thailand for 3 years, but for somehow they did it better here! Thin (10) made it for me, strongly recommended 🙏
reviewList.author: Maxim Vishnevsky (FATE)

reviewList.text:
Strong hands, attention to detail, and easy walk-in schedule set this massage service above others we have experienced so far. A massage tailored to personal pressure tolerance and focus areas in their restful massage suite began with a cup of fruity tea and ended with a delightful treat of mango yogurt. The massage its self was very effective to relieve cramped-travel muscle pain and start our stay in Danang well energized yet relaxed.
Massage therapist was very cooperative with personal preferences as they adjusted throughout the massage time. Well worth the visit!!!!
reviewList.author: Alyxius Young

reviewList.text: Found the place via google search. Staff are very friendly, took their time to explain different packages and options. The massage was good, targeting different area depending on request. Would recommend
reviewList.author: Tram Huynh

reviewList.text: LY (Number 8) is a skilled and personable massage therapist who delivers a consistently professional experience. Her technique is confident, precise, and deeply relaxing, with excellent attention to pressure and client comfort. She was attentive and considerate throughout the session, creating a welcoming and comfortable environment. I was highly satisfied with her service and would gladly recommend her.
reviewList.author: Steven Tan

reviewList.text:
This was my last-day experience before leaving Da Nang. I chose the shampoo & foot massage (60 minutes), and there was a 10% discount before 12 a.m. Unfortunately, the part I was most looking forward to didn’t happen—it turned out to be just a very ordinary shampoo massage 🤣

That said, the masseuse had great pressure, and the whole process was still comfortable.

At the end, I mentioned that I felt a bit disappointed. The staff said she was forgot and offered me a discount and even gave me a box of cookies. I felt they were very sincere, so I’m still willing to give them 5 stars 🌟.

My suggestion is to confirm the procedure with the therapist before starting.
reviewList.author: Wang Mabel (児玉ウサギ)

reviewList.text: Super lovely head wash, facial and massage! You’re greeting with tea and leave with some refreshments. Everyone was very friendly and the service was super nice - thank you Moon spa!
reviewList.author: Karena De Leon

reviewList.text: Reasonable price and good service. When I see those masseuse I know it’s just the right place to relax. They are good at finding the comfortable position of your body and make you feel released.
reviewList.author: Leo ZHU

reviewList.text: I didn't expect this place to be so hospitable, and the people are really nice. Overall, I have no complaints. They’re excellent at giving massages. I’d rate the staff and their service 101%.
reviewList.author: Florielyn Cesa

reviewList.text:
One of my best massage session in entire Vietnam 🇻🇳. Initially I was wondering if the place really good based on multiple recent  reviews by many Korean travellers.

Treatment:
90 minutes foot massage: 300,000 dong. (MYR:45) as per 1st dec 2025.

Total payment:
300,000 + 30,000 (after 10pm charge) + 9,240 (2.8% terminal charge) = 339,240 dong

The amazing:
1. Massage start 10.30pm end sharp 12.00am
2. Transparency, told me there is extra 30,000k charge as massages session from 10pm til 1am, will require it.
3. Ability to pay using wise or any credit/debit card (2.8% charge). As they have terminal to pay, also support VN pay (0.33% charge), but since I am a foreigner i only can use this method to pay for qr for businesses not to personal.
4. Hospitality: Greated me well, I whatsapp ahead of time asking if can pay using credit card and she guided me well
5. Masseuse spoke minimal english, and did really well by asking me whenever I did  flinch or looks in pain. She was super professional.
6. Super wifi speed (240mbps). Just ask password at the lady in the picture attached.
7. They gave me whole pack of snacks as they knew its my birthday tomorrow. I loved the thought and kind gestures, even we knew for just few hours. Especially the little guy who keep trying to give me more gifts. I loved her attitude. 😁😍
8. Served with hot tea and mango once massage is done. 😇🫡

The good:
1. Place looks really decent. They have upstairs with more proper layout
2. The shop is behind a convenience store. But the ladies always sit infront the convenience store to get customer and greet you.
3. Waited about 18min for the masseuse to come. As she finishing the previous customer, and i came without booking. So cant complain much.

Can improve:
1. Just toilet cleanliness. Maybe can make better.

Overall: 5/5 for me.
reviewList.author: Ravindran Rajasekaran

reviewList.text: Had the most incredible 90min hair treatment!! The service is amazing and the staff show real care. The homemade yogurt at the end is a nice touch! The is the perfect thing to do to escape the mid day heat
reviewList.author: Roydon macrae

reviewList.text: Had a very memorable experience at Me Spa on our last day in Da Nang. We decided to get the 60 minute shampoo service and it did not disappoint. We had delicious yogurt and tea after. Would do it all over again :)
reviewList.author: Alyssa Patungan

reviewList.text:
I had an absolutely wonderful experience at Me Spa in Da Nang! After a long day exploring the city, I treated myself to their relaxing full-body massage combined with the head spa treatment, and it was pure bliss. The therapist was highly skilled and professional — she used the perfect pressure to release all the tension in my back and shoulders while making me feel completely cared for.
The space is beautifully designed, spotlessly clean, and has such a calm, cozy atmosphere with soft music and natural scents. It feels like a peaceful sanctuary right in the middle of the city. I left feeling lighter, more energized, and with silky-smooth hair and a refreshed scalp. The staff were warm, attentive, and made the whole experience seamless from start to finish.
If you’re looking for high-quality, professional spa services in Da Nang, Me Spa is an excellent choice. Highly recommend — I’ll definitely be back! 🌿
reviewList.author: Ling Vu

reviewList.text:
This spa is beautiful with zen vibes and lemon grass aroma therapy. The staffs are professional especially Lisa the front desk staff. It is clean and I throughly enjoy my massage. You do have to tell them where you want to concentrate on the areas you want a stronger pressure. Lisa is super professional. My brother on the other hand said his masseuse didn’t massage his shoulders where he needed the most. He did ask to concentrate on his shoulders but the masseuse said ok ok but never massage his shoulders. He was disappointed for the price he paid. Same with my mom.
But I do recommend this location because it is clean and if you get a good masseuse it’s a worth the high price.

reviewList.text: Had a wonderful experience! The therapist, Linh, did an excellent job—very relaxing and soothing throughout. Receptionist Tracy was equally impressive, clearly explaining the services and making me feel welcome from the start. Highly recommend this spa for a calm and professional experience.

reviewList.text: So much fun getting my hair done here! My wife and I both got our hair cut and washed by Tien. I also got a keratin treatment and bleach. Our hair was styled before we left. I sent them a DM on instagram in English before we got there and was scheduled within the hour. My wife decided while we were there that she also wanted her hair done. We were given waters and taken care of super well. Tien made sure to look at all my reference videos and helped me select a style that would fit best with my face. Vi and Duong bleached my hair with a lot of care and got me to a super bright white that I've never been able to get anywhere else. I speak Vietnamese and English. It was helpful to know Vietnamese, but my wife only speaks English. It helps to have Google Translate if you don't speak any viet. They also do services privately if you need to only be worked on/seen by women. Clean, comfortable, I can't wait to come again next time I'm in Vietnam. Everyone was so nice! My hair before was so long and dry and they made it feel so healthy even after bleach. Lightening hair WILL take a long time if you have black hair like me, be prepared for that. It's typical though to be able to reach such a light color. Beauty is time!
reviewList.author: Diana Nguyen

reviewList.text:
They let me book the night before and I went in planning to get bleached highlights but the stylist recommended that I try out knotted extensions; never heard of them, but it turned out better than I thought! They took their time putting in about 200 strands (I was there for about 5hrs), and were very upfront about their pricing (they re-explained it to me about 3x)
Definitely recommend if you have the time/money!

I will note that I have thin and fine hair, which they knew, but they were pretty rough with managing my hair so I lost a lot of it…
reviewList.author: v

reviewList.text:
I did research for different hair salons before my visit to Da Nang, and I’m so glad I chose to go with Hai Stylist for this experience. I arrived at 8am and my service was done before 11am.

My stylists were Vi and Hoa. I walked in asking for color and cut. After looking at my hair, Vi recommended a keratin treatment because my hair was so dry after years of coloring and bleaching which I didn’t even know I needed. My hair has never felt more soft! And I didn’t know I could restore so much shine back into my hair!! She made sure I was happy with my hair decisions as well before proceeding as I was going from very light/bleached hair to dark.  Vi also walked me through how to treat my hair and maintain the color throughout each step of the process from haircut, coloring, blow drying, washing my hair & styling. I love that they even did a color test and were willing to let me go outside the salon into the natural daylight just to make sure I was happy with the color! This is the most hair education I’ve ever received from a stylist, and she even recommended me some of their hair products and showed me all the prices before committing. My favorite small detail here is that they give you ear covers while getting your hair done!

Vi was so personable, friendly, and really took the time to educate me about the importance of taking care of my hair after leaving Hai Stylist. Vi and Hoa worked on dying, blow drying, curling and styling my hair at the same time and I truly felt so well taken care of. When I shared my gratitude towards the end for making this experience so smooth, Hoa told me too that I deserve this and that really touched me!

This was sucha amazing experience, 10/10 recommend Hai Stylist for your hair treatment needs. I would come back the next I visit Da Nang!
reviewList.author: Jess C

reviewList.text: I went in for keratin treatment and a layered cut, they recommended a package (was around 2.800.000) with both included. I was satisfied with the results 🌸🦋💖 the staff was very caring and supportive. The woman understood what kind of haircut im asking for even with a language barrier!! You can go here without any concerns 🌅❤️‍🔥

As soon as I walked in the whole team were gorgeous, so welcoming and kind. Vi and Giap did my hair and put a 3 step keratin treatment on it. Advising me towards a much needed trim. I absolutely love Vi she made me laugh and feel fabulous. Her and Giap did an AMAZING job of my hair. Recommend to anyone who is in Da Nang. reviewList.text:
Lovely service! I had my eyebrows, lip, chin, and underarms waxed, and everything was clean, professional, and very thorough. (Which, if you’re a hairy girl like me, definitely matters.)

I had seen several positive reviews about their eyelash extensions and decided to give them a try. Wow. I absolutely love my lashes. I naturally have long lashes, but they’re very straight, and the result exceeded my expectations. They look beautiful while still feeling like me.

The staff was kind, the service was excellent, and I couldn’t be happier with the results. Highly recommend!
reviewList.author: River

reviewList.text:
We booked the 90-minute four-hands massage hoping for a relaxing and rejuvenating experience. We get massages regularly both in the US and while traveling, and have experienced four-hands treatments in many countries, so we have a solid basis for comparison.

While the massage may be acceptable by local standards, it did not feel like a true four-hands experience. The therapists were not synchronized at all. At one point, my left hand and fingers were being pulled while nothing was happening on the right side, which completely disrupted the flow a four-hands massage is meant to provide.

Communication was also very challenging. Without using a translation app, it was nearly impossible to communicate with the therapists. When I asked them to skip the bottoms of my feet, they didn’t understand. When I requested lighter pressure, they simply stopped working on that area altogether. During the session, my husband’s therapists chatted and giggled for much of the time, and my younger therapist occasionally joined in, while the older therapist remained mostly quiet. This was distracting and not relaxing—people go to spas to unwind, not to listen to staff conversations.

We had four therapists in total. The older therapist appeared to be guiding the other three, but one of the younger therapists pulled my left arm so forcefully that it caused pain, and I had to ask them to stop. The therapists also took bathroom breaks during the session. What made this uncomfortable was that they were using the bathroom inside the room, as we repeatedly heard toilet flushing, which felt unprofessional. One therapist slipped a couple of times while applying oil to my shoulder, indicating excessive oil use and poorly controlled movements. My left arm was still sore 48 hours later.

We didn't need pickup services and received the complimentary shampoo service while my husband had the foot scrub. I was led into a dimly lit room where three men were already having their hair washed, which was extremely uncomfortable. I later met them at check out and the guys also felt awkward when a stranger entered their space. I felt uneasy throughout the experience, unsure of what to expect. The stylist ended my session early, explaining that there were men in the room and took me back to the first floor to finish blow-drying my hair. For future guests, it would be helpful to clearly inform customers in advance that the shampoo area is a shared space so they can decide whether they are comfortable with that arrangement. My husband’s foot scrub, however, was fine. They also offer 15% discount off and I got a simply wax. Again, I used the translation app and it was ok.

Overall, the professionalism and coordination fell short of expectations. It wasn’t a terrible massage, but it was underwhelming and did not deliver the quality we anticipated. This service may be acceptable for guests new to four-hands massages, but for more experienced spa-goers, it may not meet expectations.
reviewList.author: S Young

Our most recent treatment was HIFU, and we were very impressed by the professionalism, attention to detail, and care we received throughout the entire procedure.
The team is always warm, welcoming, and attentive. They never rush, explain everything clearly, and make sure you feel comfortable from beginning to end. It’s rare to find a place where you can completely trust both the people and the quality of the treatments.

Thank you for taking such great care of our family. We always look forward to coming back and highly recommend NQ SPA to anyone looking for exceptional service and true professionals.

For this price, we expected a professional service and a long-lasting result. Instead, the treatment failed almost immediately. We do not want another treatment because applying strong chemicals again could further damage her hair.

We feel that we paid a very high price for a service that did not deliver what was promised. If you are a tourist considering this salon, I strongly recommend thinking twice before spending your money here. Based on our experience, we cannot recommend this salon.
