Extremely disappointed in the service. Do not recommend.
reviewList.author: Sammie chu

reviewList.text: I brought my daughter here for balayage hair color 2T3k. Salon owner badly cut layers make my daughter hair look and feel significantly thinner.  I have to take her to a new salon and pay for hair extensions 7T.  Owner didn’t do the best job, will not go back.
reviewList.author: Tony Nguyen

places.name: Hana Hair Salon 144 A3 Ông Ích Khiêm

reviewList.text: I am a foreigner and I had an amazing experience at Hana. Dat Chou and Nhi were great, made my hair look healthy and natural. Fixed my hair colour disaster(the last picture) I am glad I chose this salon. I spent 3 hours here, and it cost me 1.8 million (we used the balayage technique). All my preferences were taken into account.
reviewList.author: Anastasiia Menshutina

reviewList.text: I recently went to this salon to get my hair colored, and after searching for a good place for a long time, I definitely made the right choice. The team is very friendly and kind, offered me some treats, and they really know what they’re doing. Without bleaching my hair, I got the exact caramel-red shade I wanted from my asian hair🤭 Special thanks to the stylist Hieu, he did exactly what I asked for🥹🫶🏻
reviewList.author: Iskarova Z

reviewList.text: Hung did such an amazing job with my hair! She was incredibly thorough and really took the time to understand what I wanted. I came in looking for layers, and she gave me great advice on what would suit me best and how to maintain it. I absolutely love my new haircut—it feels fresh, flattering, and so easy to style. Highly recommend her if you’re looking for someone who truly cares about your hair!
reviewList.author: Ngoc Tran

reviewList.text:
I’m really appreciate to have Ngoc (Ngoc Gia Han) to be my stylist! I came in to get hair cut, she got what I want from the image straight away but still double check with words to confirm (with translation) it showed how professional she is. And when she cut my hair, she did it so detailed and accurate, nothing too much or too less to get the style right, very good skill. She nicely curled my hair to give it a hair style which looks so amazing and she even so carefully when spray the hairspray because she didn’t want to make the customers feel uncomfortable and greasy.
I’ll definitely go to Ngoc again next time!
reviewList.author: Annie Shih

reviewList.text:
I found Ngoc Gia Han on TikTok and decided to book an appointment with her, and I’m so happy I did! From the moment I arrived, I was welcomed so warmly with snacks and drinks, which immediately made me feel comfortable and cared for. Even with a slight language barrier, we were able to communicate everything perfectly through ChatGPT, and she was incredibly patient, kind, and attentive the entire time.

She was extremely knowledgeable and took the health of my hair very seriously. Before bleaching, she carefully did strand tests to make sure my hair could handle the process, which I really appreciated. I had asked for to transform my hair to a milk tea, light brown, ash brown color. My hair is naturally very dark, so we had to bleach it twice, and the whole appointment took about 7.5 hours, but throughout the entire process, she consistently checked in on me to make sure I was comfortable, okay, and even asked if I was hungry. You can truly tell she cares about her clients.

There were two other people working on my hair throughout the process, which made everything feel very thorough and professional. The final result turned out BEAUTIFUL, and my hair still feels so healthy afterward! I paid around $200 USD, which is honestly amazing considering this would have easily cost me $800-$1000 in California.

Overall, this was such a wonderful experience from start to finish. I felt so cared for, comfortable, and happy with the results. I would absolutely come back again and trust them with my hair in the future. Highly recommend! 💕
reviewList.author: Cynthia Nguyen

places.name: HAI STYLIST Hair Salon
places.address: 36 Châu Thị Vĩnh Tế, Ngũ Hành Sơn

reviewList.text:
I had a great experience at this salon! From the moment I arrived, the coordinator was incredibly patient and helpful with translating everything for me, which I really appreciated and made the whole experience much more comfortable.

Before starting, they took the time to properly assess the condition of my hair and recommended only the treatments that I actually needed. I also appreciated their transparent pricing, so there were no surprises.

A big thank you to Ha and Long for taking such good care of my hair. They were attentive throughout the process, regularly checking that everything was going well and making sure I left the salon happy with the results. Having two stylists work on my hair at the same time also made the appointment much quicker without compromising on quality.

My hair feels so much softer and more hydrated after the treatment. Overall, I’m very happy with the service and would definitely recommend this salon to anyone looking for professional, honest, and attentive hair care!
reviewList.author: Lee Cai Jing

reviewList.text:
I had a great experience getting a bioperm at this salon and I’m really happy with the result!

The staff were incredibly friendly and attentive. They kept checking on me throughout the whole appointment, asking if I was comfortable or if I needed anything. I was at the salon from around 9 a.m. until about 3–4 p.m., but the time flew by. Sitting for so many hours wasn’t easy, but everyone was so kind and encouraging that it made the experience much more enjoyable.

At the end, they styled my hair beautifully and gave me detailed tips on how to take care of and style my curls at home, which I really appreciated.

I paid 3.5 million VND, and the price included a haircut, the bioperm itself, and a nourishing hair treatment at the end. I think it was well worth it.

Before the appointment, I was worried that the perm might damage my hair because my hair is naturally very fine and blonde, which can be quite delicate. However, my hair stayed healthy and doesn’t feel damaged at all. The curls are holding really well, and I’m so happy with how they turned out.

On photos my hair right after the procedure (taken at home) and after the first wash 48 hours later. I’m very satisfied with the results and would definitely recommend this salon!
reviewList.author: Ирина Втюрина

reviewList.text:
Had a great experience here!

I got a cut & keratin treatment. I was in and out within 2 hours. They provided me with specialized care, were not pushy.

My hair was sooo dry before and came out looking the most silky it’s looked in ages!

Tung & Long helped me with my keratin treatment and were super gentle, personable, and most importantly were experts at their craft. I’d def recommend.
reviewList.author: Linh Nguyen

reviewList.text: I spent 4 hours and 4 million VND for a keratin treatment and haircut. This is already such an inflated price (I’m a foreigner so if you are aswell take that into considering) I had very disappointing results. My hair is very clearly damaged with either how long they kept the treatment on for or with how much they straightened my hair. My hair cut was also not done the best, my front pieces especially look chopped off and when I asked the stylist to fix the front framing pieces it was already too far gone and I don’t think anything they were doing made it better. The staff was nice, but for how long I spent there and the price this is completely not okay. It looks like a very highly rated establishment but with my experience, it was not worth it in the slightest.
reviewList.author: Armin Sandhu

reviewList.text: I’m so happy with my new hair! The haircut and color are absolutely beautiful, exactly what I wanted. Tuan is a talented and professional stylist and the whole team was kind and attentive. The service was excellent. I highly recommend this salon and Tuan to anyone looking for high-quality hair services.
reviewList.author: Anastasia Liasota

attribution.name: Hai Stylist Cơ Sở 2 Salon Tóc Đà Nẵng
Hai Stylist Cơ Sở 2 Salon Tóc Đà Nẵng

reviewList.text: One of the best massage I have ever had in my entire life and the hotstone is the highlight of the session!!! Reasonable proce and Must try!!!
reviewList.author: Sonia Chanderan

reviewList.text: The best foot massage I've ever had. Be is my massage therapist—her technique is professional and meticulous. The massage was so relaxing that we extended it from 60 to 90 minutes. Highly recommended.
reviewList.author: Ada Chen

reviewList.text:
This is a great spa and absolutely worth visiting. I’ve found massages can be very hit or miss based on past experience, but this place did not disappoint.

My husband and I had multiple massages at Anna Spa during our stay in Da Nang. It’s well run, clean, and organised. The prices are very reasonable and the therapists are excellent. I had Nga for full body massages several times and requested her again because she was consistently great. My husband saw Linh and was also very happy.

The rooms are private, the music is relaxing, and the whole place smells lovely. The fact that we kept going back says a lot.

An added bonus is the discount for repeat visits. We paid 500,000 VND each for a 2-hour massage (around $29 AUD), which felt like incredible value. We tried a mix of deep tissue and aroma massages with hot stones and both were excellent.

We’ll definitely be back when we return to Da Nang next year.
reviewList.author: mase_al

reviewList.text: A lovely spa space with excellent service and reasonable price. The receptionist and therapist are professional. I had a foot massage and it was truly relaxing! It is newly opened and I can see it will only be more popular!
reviewList.author: Lydia L.

reviewList.text: Lovely spa and clean environment! Better experience than the so called 5* spa with thousands of reviews! But would prefer if less walking up the stairs as the legs are tired. 😂😊
reviewList.author: Trang Dai

places.name: Elsa Spa massage Da Nang ( 엘사 스파 )

reviewList.text:
The staff were professional, attentive, and made me feel comfortable from the moment I arrived.
A special thanks to Receptionist Uyen, who was exceptionally welcoming, kind, and professional. She explained everything clearly, helped me choose the right treatment, and made the entire experience smooth and enjoyable. Her warm smile and excellent customer service truly stood out.
reviewList.author: Ngọc Thiện Lê

reviewList.text: I had a fantastic experience at Elsa Spa. The massage was truly relaxing and one of the best I’ve had during my trip. The staff were friendly and professional, and the spa itself was clean and beautifully maintained. Everything exceeded my expectations. If I ever visit Da Nang again, I will definitely come back for a second visit. Highly recommended
reviewList.author: Thảo Vy Trần Ngọc

reviewList.text:
If zero stars were possible, this place would deserve it.

This was by far the worst massage experience of my life. I travel frequently and have had massages all over the world, so I know what a professional treatment should feel like and this was the complete opposite.

The therapist was extremely unprofessional. She was wearing a ring during the massage, which caused discomfort and scratching on my skin. Her technique was very fast, rough, and careless, making the experience painful rather than relaxing. I repeatedly asked her to slow down and use more oil, but she did not properly respond to my requests. Even after her colleague translated, she continued the same harsh movements, creating friction that felt like burning on my skin.

I had to stop the session multiple times because it was simply unbearable. There was no sense of care, skill, or professionalism.

Although the reception staff was friendly and they served mango and tea at the end, this does not make up for the terrible core service. A massage should be about relaxation and well-being not discomfort and frustration.

I strongly do not recommend this place. Please be cautious !!
reviewList.author: Tanthita Putthiboonsawat

reviewList.text: Was greeted by friendly front desk n cute pupppppyyyyyy aaaaaaaa
reviewList.author: Samantha S

reviewList.text: Had a 30 minute shampoo/head massage, was a great experience. Fresh mango at the end was a nice touch, didn’t feel a rush to leave.
reviewList.author: Jade Verberne

attribution.name: Elsa Spa massage Da Nang ( 엘사 스파 )
Elsa Spa massage Da Nang ( 엘사 스파 )
Elsa Spa massage Da Nang ( 엘사 스파 )
Elsa Spa massage Da Nang ( 엘사 스파 )

reviewList.text:
One of the best aesthetic experiences I’ve had in Da Nang.

I came in for RF microneedling and Botox, and what stood out most was how personalized the treatment felt. The practitioner adjusted the RF depth and settings based on different areas of my face rather than using a one-size-fits-all approach, taking extra care around my under-eye area, nasolabial folds, and areas of concern. The attention to detail was impressive.

The staff were kind, professional, communicative, and patient throughout the entire process. As someone who is nervous around needles, I especially appreciated how accommodating they were and how comfortable they made me feel. Aftercare guide was thoughtful too.

The clinic was clean, well-organized, and never felt rushed. I left feeling confident that I was in experienced hands and genuinely cared for as a client.

If you’re looking for natural-looking results, thoughtful treatment planning, and excellent service in Da Nang, I highly recommend this clinic. I’ll definitely be returning.
reviewList.author: Isabelle Kent

reviewList.text:
Randomly stumbled on this little place while walking in my hotels neighborhood and wanted to share my appreciation for the excellent care I received. During my visit, I received a hydro-facial, light micro needling, botox, and filler along with some red light therapy, all this at a fraction of the cost it would be in USA.

I was particularly impressed by the doctor's recommendation against additional procedures I had requested. This level of integrity speaks volumes about your high ethical standards and demonstrates that you truly prioritize patient care over profit.

Thank you for the wonderful experience. I highly recommend your services and look forward to returning the next time my travels bring me back to Da Nang.
reviewList.author: Miro Didyk

reviewList.text:
My boyfriend and I both had facials and microneedling treatments. I was able to book my treatment through Facebook very easily, the communication was great and friendly.

The location was easy to find and it was very clean and professional. I had a face consultation that was quick and informative!

My aesthetician was Hoa, she took great care of me, making sure nothing was hurting and I felt comfortable throughout my experience. She showed me the needles she was using, and made sure I knew the needles were new from unopened packages, which I appreciated!

Overall I am highly satisfied with my experience, from the easy booking process, professional staff, clean and nice facility, and the results. I would recommend Hieu Dep to anyone looking for a quality treatment.
reviewList.author: Jade Verberne

reviewList.text: I received the facial service with the chemical peal, and laser hair removal. The staff were so kind and told me everything they were doing before they do it. They even gave recommendations for products for my skin type. Great staff, great place, great prices! Highly recommend
reviewList.author: Trinity Lewis-morales

reviewList.text: My husband and I went here for facials. They scanned our skin before the treatment and sat down with us to explain our individualized results, which was very informative. The clinic was clean and sanitary but not the most private or relaxing. I also got microneedling and masseter Botox, both of which were completed in a professional and pain-free manner. I would definitely recommend coming here!
reviewList.author: K N

places.name: Bliss Spa & Shampoo - Hair Wash, Shampoo Danang - Gội Đầu Dưỡng Sinh

reviewList.text: Today I had an exhausting day and by chance I was walking around here and found this place. I had a massage and shampoo (for the first time). I felt very well taken care of from the beginning (welcomed with tea), through the middle (a great professional washing my hair and massaging my shoulders and arms very well), to the end (mango lassi and impeccably hydrated hair). I highly recommend this place!
reviewList.author: Lau Loretto

reviewList.text: I had hair, neck, and shoulder shampoo massage and its so good. Plus they even gave me a fruit tea and mango yogurt which are cherry on top. Love the experience, will definitely come back here ❤️🤗 thank you Bliss Spa 💕
reviewList.author: Ronaliza Villezar

reviewList.text: I tried a Vietnamese-style hair wash near my hotel. It was a 90-minute session and cost only 400,000 VND. The package included a head massage, neck and shoulder massage, hand massage, and foot massage — totally worth it. The staff were really friendly and kept checking if I was comfortable. They also served snacks and drinks, including a strawberry smoothie.
reviewList.author: AJ

reviewList.text:
This place is very good hair wash and shoulder massage
Staff so kind and good at massage so so much
Strong recommended to get fresh and relaxing
reviewList.author: Tidadoi .S

reviewList.text:
Phenomenal experience - around 400k for a deep tissue massage. Therapist was very talented, great balance of of pressure and targeting problematic areas. Feel so much better afterwards.

No booking was needed, they even included a tea and smoothie after the massage. Everyone was extremely friendly and pleasant The numerous 5 star reviews are absolutely correct :)

reviewList.author: Zolzaya Bolderdene

reviewList.text: The massage was so great it made me fall asleep a few times and even snore 😂 They also serve snacks before and after your session. The reception is also welcoming. Over all it was super relaxing!!! I wish I can come back again someday.

reviewList.text: So good experience stuff is so kind and helpful I had head shampoo and massage it was so good thank you so much
reviewList.author: Zuleyha Chariyeva

reviewList.text: Really good experience! The massage was so comfortable, the place was clean and the staff is very nice. Recommend!

reviewList.author: YS N

Mo Ran Spa Massage Da Nang

reviewList.text: This massage place is super peaceful and relaxing unlike other places along the road. We had nice massage and were offered free drinks afterwards. I like this little touch.
reviewList.author: Liza

reviewList.text: First massage in Da Nang and it didn’t disappoint at all! I highly recommend Hong for body massage (medium pressure) and hair wash. She hit all the right places and seems very experience. Place is very clean and staff were all so helpful. I will definitely return every time I visit Da Nang, Vietnam.
reviewList.author: Diana Huynh

reviewList.text: This spa, massage, and barbershop is run by a Korean owner! The massages are refreshing and gentle, and the service is excellent and friendly. And since they also run a cafe, you can enjoy a leisurely cup of coffee before you leave!
reviewList.author: joonho son

reviewList.text:
Tried body(aroma) massage 1 hour. You can choose your favourite aroma out of 5, lavender, slang slang, coconut, lemongrass and orange. Therapists will adjust their massage techniques according to your preference (you write a consultation sheet before massage). They privide drinks before and after massage.
It was a very relaxing and pleasant, thanks a lot!
reviewList.author: Satomi Kawabata

reviewList.text: Super happy woth my experience and I feel great. The prices are amazing. I recommend the Aroma Body Massage and A Ear Cleam Combo. Everything about the shop is excellent and everyone is extremely helpful, friendly, and professional.
reviewList.author: ivy chae

places.name: Gội đầu dưỡng sinh Đà Nẵng - LaLien Spa Massage body
places.address: Lô 21 An Thượng 34, Ngũ Hành Sơn

reviewList.text:
Service:
- When I visited, everyone I interacted with was friendly, and although they didn’t speak English and I don’t speak Vietnamese, we communicated using Google translator.
- Rating: 5/5

Atmosphere:
- The massage beds are comfortable.
- Everything is clean.
- During my massage they played some relaxing music.
- When required, to keep you cool, they have air conditioning and fans.
- Rating: 5/5

Service:
- 60 minute full body massage.
- My treatment started off with some fresh fruit and a bottle of water. I then got changed, and a lady washed my feet, then I was taken upstairs to the massage beds, where my full body massage began. Once finished, I was escorted downstairs, where I was given a menu where I could choose a complimentary drink.
- Although I only booked the standard body massage, I’m pleased to say they also used hot stones, which felt great and was very much appreciated.
- A special thank you to my masseuse, Too Ten Xuan a, who was absolutely amazing! Highly recommend!
- Price: 300K
- Rating: 5/5

If you’re looking a great massage at a reasonable price, I highly recommend La Lien Spa.

Overall Rating: 5/5
reviewList.author: Steve Hilton

reviewList.text:
This was my very first massage in Da Nang and since there is so many options I did not expect much. Travis from Da Nang Social Club recommended this place for a hair spa/wash and I was like ok, hopefully they do good massage too, let's see🫠

But what I received?!!!😍 45 minutes of an absolute BLISS super strong back massage with hot stones, head massage front/back, my massuse Tha (she is tiny but so strong and knows what she's doing, wow!) exactlty knew what spots to focus on, the pressure was absolutely amazing & strong and as Im writing this review Im here with a free pineapple juice, in a nice calm atmoshphere, and I feel soooo relaxed and my trapese are 100% softer and lighter.

I got so lucky finding Tha as the first massage therapist in Da Nang it feels illegal!🤣

I will only go to her from now on.

So grateful, 5/5, highly recommend!!!! THIS IS IT (and i am a massage pro - even lived in Bali and this was better!)
reviewList.author: Martiny Tomash

reviewList.text: Great experience overall. Tha was a fantastic therapist - very good massage, and very relaxing and professional. I went for the 90 minute head spa, which included a facial, neck and shoulder massage and foot massage. Included a fresh juice at the end - lovely!!
reviewList.author: Rosie Woulfe

reviewList.text:
I highly recommend this spa! 🤍

I tried the 90-minute hot stone massage and honestly had such a great experience.

First of all, the atmosphere was so peaceful, cozy, and relaxing. The moment I walked in, I already felt calmer 😌

My therapist was ms. Hoang, and she was amazing! She has really strong hands and clearly knows what she’s doing. The pressure was perfect, the massage techniques felt very professional, and the hot stone treatment was incredibly relaxing.

What I liked most was that she kept checking if the pressure was okay and made sure I was comfortable throughout the session. She was also very friendly and easy to talk to. If you’re coming here, definitely book with Ms. Hoang! ❤️

I’m 100% a local, not a tourist, so trust me on this one 😂 I’ve tried plenty of massage places in Da Nang already

I’ll definitely be back again, even though it’s quite far from my house hahahaa!
reviewList.author: Yến Thuận

reviewList.text: One of my best massages ever! I feel like all my sore muscles were treated. My masseuse constantly asks if I'm good. Lots of complimentary snacks and drinks, as well, before and after my massage. Would recommend!!
reviewList.author: Kimberly Gonzales

attribution.name: Gội đầu dưỡng sinh Đà Nẵng - LaLien Spa Massage body

places.name: Tun Beauty Salon & Spa
places.address: 238 Đ. Trần Hưng Đạo, An Hải

reviewList.text:
I cannot say enough good things about my experience at Tun Beauty! I have thin, fine hair that easily falls out due to an autoimmune disease, so finding a stylist I can truly trust is incredibly rare.
I originally came in wanting a cut just below my shoulders, but my master stylist, Bao, politely gave me his honest professional advice. Everything he said made complete sense for my hair type. I decided to trust his expertise entirely and gave him full control. I just told him I needed something low-maintenance with natural volume, since I’m a total "wash and go" girl.
Bao absolutely delivered! He gave me the perfect cut that suits me, boosts my hair's volume, and is so easy to style.
Huge shout-out to Hieu and Yen for assisting and making the whole experience so seamless and welcoming. If you have fine or challenging hair, go see Bao—he is a true professional!
reviewList.author: Nga T

reviewList.text: Best pedicure ever! Pi was so detailed-focused and the nail bed preparation before painting was sensational. I was so happy with my nails! The salon itself is gorgeous, the colours inside & architecture are beautiful. We will definitely be back!
reviewList.author: Mia Thompson

reviewList.text: I walked in to Tun for a haircut and realized that they did perms too for a great price! I’ve always wanted the Korean style haircut and perm and Bao delivered exactly what I was looking for with his expertise! I was on a tight schedule and had to catch a flight, and the whole team jumped in to help me stay on time without ever rushing the quality. It was an amazing experience from start to finish, and I’d highly recommend this salon!
reviewList.author: Emily Xiao

reviewList.text:
Went here for a 100 minute spa combo and a haircut by a designer stylist for men.

Super happy with the attention to detail,  and service making me feel comfortable even though there was a language barrier. However they have staff speaking english so there never was a problem.

I actually felt like I wanted to send Swedish hair dressers here for an education :p. 10/10 and I stornly recommend it.

Regarding the aroma massage, I enjoyed it.

However one improvement I would recommend Tun to implement is to have a paper with a body, where the customer can choose pressure, placed to focus extra attention on and places to avoid (like pulling fingers and toes is not something that I like).

Another improvement would be to ask customers having a pedicure /manicure just next to the massage beds to be more quiet and not so loud, because that destroys the relaxing atmosphere I really wanted.

The massage experience was 4/5.

And lastly the Hair Spa. This was my least favorite with the most room for improvement.

They used some moisturizer that they smear over the eyes, which cause some tears / irritation. And they smear it over the eyes 1-15 times during the treatment until I had to say stop. And I wish I had done that sooner. The eyes doesn’t need that treatment. Instead, please use eye skin care moisturizer under the eyes.

Also, the head massage lacked ”feeling”, and felt mechanical and fast paced instead of slow and relaxing. To improve it further I would use a product that smells better, and maybe is adopted to the customers scalp profile (dry, oily, dandruff etc).

I would give the hair spa 1,5/5.

All in all, this place is great, and even though room for improvement I think they will really listen to feedback and make their services even more world class.

Haircut was: 100,000VND
Spa combo: 660,000VND
reviewList.author: R S

reviewList.text: It was my first salon experience in Vietnam and I am definitely impressed. I came in for doing my nails and coloring my hair and it was by far the quickest and most efficient service in my life! My nails were literally done so well and in a jiffy and I had never before had 3 people work on my hair simultaneously. Despite not knowing vietnamese they went out of their way to understand what I wanted and I'm really grateful for their excellent service! And they were very upfront about the cost of all services and at no point did they try to push any products or extra services. If I'm ever back in Vietnam, I'm coming back 💜.
reviewList.author: Anjitha

reviewList.text:
We came across this massage place while having dinner nearby and decided to give it a try after walking around all day. It turned out to be such a pleasant experience. The staff were friendly, welcoming, and attentive throughout the session, making us feel comfortable from start to finish.
We left feeling relaxed and really happy with the service. We'll definitely be coming back again during the rest of our stay. Highly recommended if you're looking to end your day with a relaxing massage and a good night's sleep
reviewList.author: Cassie Lourdes

reviewList.text: What a relaxing experience! We started with an amazing foot scrub and then shampoo and relax package and a four hands massage. It was relaxing, professional, and very clean. Highly recommend!
reviewList.author: Allysse Ivetic

reviewList.text:
The massage is great and the owner is very sweet. The place is clean and pleasant. After a long walk, they perfectly stretched out my body and relieved all the fatigue. Highly recommend! Very welcoming atmosphere
👍#massage #danang #relax #travel
reviewList.author: Ирина Юн

reviewList.text:
Cutes staff greetings outside, took us in without prior reservation- we gave 30 min heads up for 3 women. The massagers asked throughout if we were okay, amazing products, hair and skin soft like a baby butt! Smells amazing and we were handled with suck care and tenderness. Neck muscles smooth like butter. 100% worth the money!

We hope their partners appreciate them
reviewList.author: Astrid Aarup

reviewList.text: We had a lovely afternoon.  The girls were charming, friendly, and did wonderful work.  My husband felt so peaceful he took a nap and woke up feeling refreshed.  I received wonderful a massage of hands, feet, and most importantly neck area.  Plus the hair washing was divine.  A quaint little shop, absolutely worth a visit.
reviewList.author: Michelle

reviewList.text: Traveling to Da Nang and wanted to find a hair salon nearby for a quick hair dye and stumbled upon this hair salon near the hotel. My overall experience was pleasant! The owner of the hair salon explained the process thoroughly and I appreciated how he went through the cost to confirm with me beforehand. He made the effort to communicate and gave me a truly personable experience. The owner has many years of experience and you can definitely tell he takes ownership for the quality of his work. His assistants were also amazing and are very friendly. Highly recommend this salon for anyone visiting the area for professional haircuts and hair coloring. I will visit again when I’m traveling to Da Nang!
reviewList.author: l Einna

reviewList.text:
Permanent straightening-
Such a great experience! The staff were kind, knowledgeable, and very efficient—my daughter’s straight perm was done in just 3 hours. The owner was honest and upfront about pricing, which I loved. No wonder this place has such high ratings!
reviewList.author: Julie Pham

reviewList.text: I can’t stress how much I am in love with my new hair style and color. Duoc is truly a master at his craftsmanship. He and his wife life took good care of my hair from start to finish.  Duoc brought my hair back to life. He is genuinely the sweetest stylist I have ever met. I highly recommend him and the services he provides 10 Stars for sure!!!
reviewList.author: Bella Sera

reviewList.text: I really loved this salon! I came in without a specific haircut in mind—I just wanted to cut off all the damaged ends. The result turned out so cute, and I’m really happy with my new haircut. A huge thank you to hairstylist! ☺️
reviewList.author: Sveta

places.name: Nón Spa - Massage, Nail, Hair Washing, Facial and Skin care

reviewList.text:
Non Spa in the An Thuong area of Da Nang was an excellent experience. The location is perfect—right in the heart of the tourist area, making it easy to visit after dinner or a long day at the beach.

The atmosphere was calm, clean, and very relaxing. The massage was top-quality, with skilled therapists who knew exactly how to relieve tension and fatigue. I left feeling completely refreshed.

What I really liked was the balance between professionalism and comfort. It felt well-managed and consistent, which is not always easy to find in busy tourist areas.

If you’re staying around An Thuong and looking for a reliable and high-quality massage, this place is definitely worth it. Highly recommended.

reviewList.text:

Will visit again if I travel to Da Nang.

A special mention to the staff for their attention to detail and warm hospitality. It was a perfect relaxing experience for us as a couple during our Da Nang trip.
Highly recommended for anyone looking for a professional and relaxing spa experience in Da Nang!

reviewList.text:
Exceptional Customer Care, Professionalism, and Skill
​I want to express my sincere gratitude to the owner and the entire team at LOC Hair Salon for their outstanding customer service and professional dedication.
​I returned to the salon today to discuss my hair, and I could not be more impressed with how gracefully and politely they handled everything. I have difficult, fine hair, but the team listened carefully, took their time, and expertly fixed both the cut and the treatment. My hair is now beautifully shaped, smooth, and soft.
​The level of professionalism, kindness, and genuine care they showed—even giving me a thoughtful gift before I left—was truly wonderful. It is rare to find a salon that stands behind their work with such dedication to customer satisfaction. I am extremely happy with my hair now and highly recommend them to anyone looking for a skilled, welcoming team in Da Nang!

reviewList.text:
I decided to stop by to see if they could fit me in for a foot massage, and I was accomodated on the spot. The friendly receptionist Jeannie made me feel welcome,and explained all the options for my massage very clearly.  I was also able to add my neck and shoulders to be massaged, as well as my legs and feet. My massage therapist Vuoung was very skillful, and applied just the right pressure to my aching muscles. It was one one of the best massages I've had so far in Da Nang.
The facilities are very calm, quiet, clean, and is surrounded by beautiful Buddhist statues.
In contrast to other spas in Da Nang, I wasn't pressured to immediately write a review as is very common with other big spas here. I appreciated that very much.
Thank you for a wonderful experience today!

reviewList.text:
I visited Noah Spa, which was conveniently located beside my hotel. With no prior expectations, I opted for their premium stone massage package.  I can confidently say that I had the best massage ever.

During my four-night stay in Danang, I visited Noah Spa on my second night and ended up spending three consecutive nights there.
I wish Noah Spa could expand and open more branches so that more people could experience their exceptional service.

Hats off to the young couple who own the spa for their efforts in providing outstanding service. They deserve to open a training facility to share their expertise.

Special thanks to my therapist, Vuong, and the entire team for their soulful service.

places.address: 51 Nguyễn Thị Minh Khai, Hải Châu

reviewList.text: Danang is full of so many spas it’s impossible to choose. Hopefully this review will make it easy…From the door greeting to the farewell, the staff at Da Spa were so gracious and kind, and non-aggressive or pushy like all the other places. We came in too late to get the 90 minute massage that we had been looking for but the wonderful hostess Vy Vo suggested a shorter more targeted massage. We were led to a modern and tastefully furnished room for two,  comfortably cool given the suffocating heat outside and soothingly scented. Our neck shoulder and nape massage was one of the best I have ever had, better than in Europe, US, and South Korea. Afterwards, we were treated with such pampering care, with a nourishing treat and rest, before we went back out into the bustle and heat that is Da Nang in July. This spa is a true oasis in the city…we plan to return as many times as we can during the rest of our trip!

reviewList.text: Best massage in da nang! 10/10 customer service and plenty of snacks provided. Will definitely be coming back

reviewList.text: Had a wonderful experience here! The staff was friendly, professional, and made me feel very relaxed. The spa was clean, peaceful, and the massage was excellent. I left feeling refreshed and would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Da Nang!

places.name: Thương Ta Spa
places.address: 189 Phan Châu Trinh, Ninh, Hải Châu

reviewList.text:
I recently had the chance to experience Thương Ta Spa while visiting Da Nang, and I was truly very satisfied. It’s a local spa, but the service is highly professional. From the cozy atmosphere to the attentive service, everything made me feel comfortable right from the moment I walked in.

The staff here are extremely enthusiastic and friendly. They always checked in gently and adjusted the massage pressure to suit my preference. I was especially impressed with the bamboo massage — it felt very different from regular massages. The pressure was even and deep, and after the session, my body felt much lighter and noticeably more relaxed.

In addition, the herbal nourishing hair wash is definitely worth trying. Every step was done very carefully, using lightly scented herbal ingredients. The head, shoulder, and neck massage was incredibly relaxing — I almost fell asleep during the treatment. After finishing, my mind felt much more relaxed and refreshed.

What surprised me the most was the price, which is very reasonable compared to the quality of service. It was honestly an unexpectedly good price for such attentive and well-done care, making it feel truly worth the money.

Overall, I would say this is a local spa that operates with great professionalism, excellent service, and very dedicated staff. If I have the chance to visit Da Nang again, I will definitely return to Thương Ta Spa for another experience.
reviewList.author: tran vinh

reviewList.text: Hubby had a lovely full body oil massage upstairs quieter. I had the head massage and hair wash it was ridiculous the noise with other people waiting, and kids playing. Couldn’t relax disappointed. Some guests got a yoghurt after I got nothing not even a drink! 189k for the head and hair the shoulder and arm massage lasted seconds!! She kept disappearing! I wouldn’t recommend! But hubby said his massage was good!

reviewList.text: This is my second time coming back because I was truly impressed with the decoration and ambiance. The space is very clean, and the customer service is attentive and thoughtful. reviewList.text:

Initially, I thought the 189k for shampoo was a bit high, but the 60-minute treatment includes hot stone neck & shoulder massage and basic facial with pore vacuum machine, so actually, a deal. My gal did an excellent job and their hair product smells divine.

It's not a hair salon, so no blowout (just basic blowdry), but the spa is modern and tidy, and the 60m shampoo is arguably the best service if its kind I've experienced in Vietnam.

Will definitely be back, even if we're not having hotpot!

My girlfriend and I just finished a massage here, and it was a really nice experience. We went at night right before sleep, and even at nighttime the views and scenery were beautiful. The environment is relaxing, clean, and well set up, and the overall atmosphere feels premium and calm. I chose an aroma massage in medium strength. It was relaxing, but for me it was a bit too light, next time I’ll definitely choose a stronger pressure and stronger aroma. Still, the therapist did a great job and we left feeling refreshed.

Overall, great setting, great vibe, and a very enjoyable massage. We’ll come back again and I highly recommend it if you want to relax with a nice view.

I contacted the studio per WhatsApp and we made an appointment quickly.
I needed to do a regular polish removal, shorten and polish my nails a little, also add hardener gel and then finally to finish my nails with a gel polish. I sent a picture as an example what I would like to get in the end, but in a different colors. And I got exactly the result I had in my mind! 😻🤌
The place is super cozy and cute and there’s a good background music, too.
The stylist is friendly and speaks English perfectly, so I had no problems in communicating at all.
It‘s also the first studio that uses the gloves while using the UV-lamp! That’s very thoughtful and important.
I’ll definitely come here next time, when I’m in Da Nang again. 🙏💜

UPD.
I also came here with my husband after a few days for a massage with hot stones and shampoo.

reviewList.text:
Having seen numerous positive reviews and photos for An Spa & Beauty in Da Nang, I decided to give them a try. Visiting at night, the atmosphere seemed a bit different from what the photos suggested (I've attached some for reference). I chose the gel manicure and pedicure package.

I was happy with the quality of the nail services. They did an excellent job, and my nails look fantastic. I appreciated their color recommendations, which were spot-on for my skin tone.

During the manicure, however, a standard step seemed to be missing. In many salons, hands are soaked in water to soften the cuticles, making them easier to remove and allowing for a more thorough hand scrub. This soaking process was absent during our service. I'm not sure if they were rushed, but it felt like a departure from the norm. Regrettably, my partner experienced a slight cut to their cuticle during the removal process, which caused some pain.

Our total bill came to 1,150,000 Vietnamese Dong (SGD 58ish)

While the nail treatments were good, I believe there's room for improvement in their service procedures and the overall upkeep of the shop.

reviewList.text: I had a wonderful experience at An Spa & Beauty . The salon is clean, modern, and beautifully decorated. Overall, it’s a relaxing and enjoyable place to visit. Highly recommended! 💕😊 Thank you An, See you next time 🙏

reviewList.text:
I joined the Sound Healing session at Maia Spa with “Sanjay”, and it was one of the most memorable experiences of my stay at Fusion Resort.

Since there were almost no reviews, I wasn’t sure what to expect. For anyone wondering, the session is held while lying comfortably on a yoga mat with your eyes closed. Sanjay uses singing bowls, rain sticks, and other sound healing instruments, filling the entire space with gentle vibrations and soothing sounds that create a deeply relaxing and immersive experience.

The atmosphere was so peaceful that a few participants appeared to fall asleep not long after the session began—not because it was boring, but because it was incredibly calming and relaxing.

What made the experience truly special was Sanjay’s gentle and thoughtful guidance. His attention to detail helped me completely let go of stress and be fully present in the moment. By the end of the session, I felt refreshed, peaceful, and genuinely healed.

Among all the activities I enjoyed at Fusion Resort, this is the one I will remember the most. Thank you, Sanjay, for creating such a beautiful healing experience. It is a memory I will carry with me for a long time, and I highly recommend it to anyone visiting the resort.
reviewList.author: Dong hee Kim

reviewList.text: A special thanks to Master Phi, the yoga instructor, for his detailed guidance and genuine enthusiasm. His sessions were not only professional but also inspiring, helping me feel more balanced and connected throughout the stay.

Overall Experience: 10/10 ⭐
Glow Spa has become a personal favorite – I’ve already been three times, and that alone says a lot. Each visit has been consistently excellent. From relaxation to muscle relief, it hits every mark. Easily one of the best spa experiences I’ve had.

Massage Quality: 9/10 ⭐
The massage is detailed and effective. She worked through every knot and kept checking in to make sure the pressure was just right. What really stood out was how carefully she cleaned off the massage oil afterward – I left feeling refreshed, not greasy.

Therapist Professionalism: 9/10 ⭐
Very respectful and attentive. The therapist listens, adjusts when needed, and shows genuine care throughout the session.

Cleanliness & Hygiene: 9/10 ⭐
Everything is spotless – from the rooms to the towels and tools. The overall hygiene level gives you confidence from the moment you walk in.

Atmosphere: 8/10 ⭐
Soothing music, a calm environment, and a peaceful setup. It’s easy to switch off and unwind here. With a little more ambient detail, it could be even better – but it’s already very solid.

Prices & Value: 9/10 ⭐
The pricing is more than fair for what you get: 280.000 VND for 60 minutes and 380.000 VND for 90 minutes of full-body massage. Considering the quality, attention to detail, and all the little extras, it’s excellent value for money.

Extras / Notes:
You’re welcomed with a free peach iced tea, followed by a foot bath, and after the massage, you get fresh mango and more iced tea. The relaxing music adds to the calm vibe. The therapist takes time to wipe off excess oil properly – a rare and appreciated touch.

Would I recommend it?
Yes – 100%. I’ve been 3 times already because it’s that good. Excellent technique, consistent quality, and a full experience that feels premium.

reviewList.text:
I booked an appointment online, and the available 10:00 AM slot was with Dat.

Upon arrival, I was handed an intake form to fill out. Among other things, there was a question about massage pressure, I selected "mild", or same. Not strong.

On the positive side: spacious venue, clean restroom, and a pleasant, friendly master, even though he didn't speak English. The haircut looked just fine at first glance.

What I didn't like: during the shampoo, the girl was scratching my scalp with her nails, which is a breach of professional standards. Despite the intake form asking about massage intensity, I didn't get a single minute of one. Considering the cost of the haircut, even for a local master, they could have done a couple of minutes of lymphatic massage on the neck and scalp, if only out of basic courtesy. As a rule, a light massage is included almost everywhere in Da Nang, but that wasn't the case here. For some reason, the girl started applying heavy pressure to my head, which began triggering a migraine, so I had to tell her to stop. I was very upset by how poorly the hair washing went and the complete lack of massage, even a light one.

Next, I discussed the haircut with the master, and we agreed on what to do. What I disliked again: I was given a used cape after a previous client (🫪 !???). My phone and I ended up covered in short black hairs, and I had to brush myself and my phone off after the haircut. This is a severe violation of sanitary standards.

The master, Dat, was quite attentive to my requests. The final result but differed from what we agreed on, but overall it was okay. I didn't have high expectations despite the glowing Google reviews. I'll get a clearer picture after washing my hair at home.

They barely blow-dried my hair, applied no styling products at all, and just added a tiny bit of hair oil. Overall, there was a feeling of being shortchanged, it didn't feel like a complete service, even though the price is double that of many local masters. If I had paid 800,000 VND for this service, I would have been defo deeply dissatisfied.

In Thailand, for example in Phuket at Central Festival, the price of a haircut at a decent salon with a top master comes out the same as a local one here, but you leave with a finished cut, minimal styling, and at least a short massage included.

I suggest paying special attention to the quality of the hair washing service and ensuring clients are provided with clean capes. Also, asking clients for shooting, pics and reviews feels a bit off. Well, you asked for a review, here it is 🙏🏼

reviewList.text:
This place may be acceptable to locals, but there are some issues here:

1) The guests seeking relaxation services should never be taken to the room upstairs because it is too brightly lit and clinical. That room should only be used for clients seeking more serious treatments from that older male therapist.

2) Some foot soaking buckets need to be repaired, as the wooden studs on the floorboard have fallen off—so the feet are stepping on sharp nails.

3) Body massages should not be performed on hair washing beds—because laying face down forces breathing into the sink of sewage pipe with no opening for airflow. It is nauseating.

4) Clean towels should be placed between the face/bed and body/bed for better hygiene between guests.

5) The feather stick ear tool should not be used inside the guests' ears during hair washes—as it is not properly disinfected between uses. It gave me an ear infection.

6) Water and soap should not be put into the ear canals—since the technicians do not properly know how to dry them. Giving the guests cotton swabs is not enough.

7) The technician should never use their nails to scratch the scalp during hair washes—it damages hair follicles that increases hair fall and oil production.

8) Some guests don't use indoor speaking voices—so the relaxation aspects are gone.

9) The service menu needs to be printed with the current pricing. They cannot raise and change the price on the customer at the cash register.

This is a difficult review to leave as Hana Spa employs cute staff. But until their standards and practices improve, it will be difficult for them to make loyal customers who know about quality spa services.

reviewList.text:
My wife and I had such a fantastic experience at Len Spa in Da Nang!

From the moment we walked through the door, the team made us feel genuinely welcome. We were greeted with refreshing water and snacks before enjoying an amazing 60-minute full-body Thai massage together.

The massage itself was exceptional — professional, relaxing and exactly what our bodies needed after spending our days exploring beautiful Da Nang. What really made the experience stand out, though, was the team. Everyone was so friendly, fun and warm, and you could genuinely feel the positive energy throughout the spa.

There’s something special about finding a place where the service is professional but the people still make you feel completely comfortable and at home. Len Spa certainly delivered that for us.

A huge thank you to the wonderful team for looking after my wife and me and making our visit so enjoyable. We walked out relaxed, refreshed and smiling!

We would happily recommend Len Spa to anyone visiting Da Nang and will definitely be back when we return to this beautiful city.

Cảm ơn rất nhiều! 🇻🇳
With love from your Australian friends,
Mark & Bella

reviewList.text:
We had a really lovely experience here from start to finish.

As soon as you arrive, you’re given spa slippers and welcomed by one or two very friendly staff members who bring you the treatment menu. There’s no pressure at all, so you can take your time choosing what you would like. It’s also worth checking for their Happy Hour offers, as they sometimes have 20% discount.

While you’re deciding, you receive a refreshing flavored water. Before the treatment, you fill in a short form where you can mention any pain, sensitive areas, or parts of the body you would prefer them not to massage. You can also choose between three different massage oils.

After that, you’re taken to the treatment room and given special satin underwear to change into. Women also receive a top. The treatment starts with a relaxing warm foot bath before the actual massage begins.

The massage itself was excellent professional, relaxing and very well done. The massage therapists don’t speak much English, but this wasn’t a problem at all. A member of the reception staff regularly checks in during the treatment to make sure everything is comfortable, so you can easily ask for more or less pressure if needed.

Payment is made before the treatment, which makes everything very easy afterwards. When you come back downstairs, you’re served another drink together with watermelon and a small biscuit, which is a really nice finishing touch.

Overall, the whole experience feels organised, clean, thoughtful and welcoming. The staff are extremely friendly and they clearly pay attention to the little details. We would definitely recommend this spa if you’re looking for a good massage in Da Nang.
reviewList.author: L VB

reviewList.text: We had a bamboo massage and a facial, and they were honestly the best treatments we’ve had so far in Vietnam. The pressure was exactly right—not too soft and not painfully hard—and everything felt professional and relaxing. We both left feeling completely refreshed. reviewList.author: Bas B

reviewList.text: After visiting several spas in Da Nang, here is my review of this one. My husband and I chose Combo 1 for 650,000 VND (apparently a 50% discount) for 110 minutes, which included a 70-minute Thai massage and a 40-minute facial treatment with shampoo. 1) Reception and facilities: 4/5. Friendly welcome and clean place. We were served tea, and our information was taken (health, preferences, etc.). Our appointment was at 2:00 PM, and we entered the massage room at 2:10 PM. After changing, etc., we started at 2:15 PM. 2) Massage service: 3/5. The foot wash and scrub lasted 1 minute before we got on the table. The protocol was good, the pressure was appropriate... for those who are ticklish, the masseuse climbs onto your back and uses techniques with her knee, applying pressure and stretching.  The masseuse asked if everything was alright. The massage lasted 55 minutes, not 70 minutes as advertised (since we finished at 3:10 PM). Regarding the facial and shampoo service, I give it 3/5. The facial included a simple cleansing, a simple scrub, and a disposable sheet mask. While the mask was on, they shampooed and massaged my scalp. I'm not giving it a high rating because during the facial, they turned my head from left to right each time they cleaned my face, so you end up with drops of water either in your nose or ears, and you can't relax. The hair washing wasn't done with the showerheads but with a handheld showerhead, which explains the left-to-right movement. This service lasted 35 minutes (including hair drying).  Upon leaving, we were offered tea, two gelatos, and coconut crackers. Overall, I would say the service was satisfactory, the staff was friendly, the setting was pleasant, and the prices were reasonable. However, I would suggest that the time allotted for the service by customers should be respected.

Body massage
•	The spa asked me to fill in a preference sheet, but key requests were ignored: I selected lavender oil yet smelled strongly of coconut oil, and I ticked “no neck massage” but still received neck work.
•	Pressure was far below medium, many areas were missed (arms and thighs were barely touched), and the therapist often failed to locate or work on actual tension points, which suggests poor training and low effort.
Strange massage techniques
•	The therapist repeatedly tapped and rubbed my toes in a way that felt more like someone trying to start a fire with a stick than a relaxing treatment, and this happened three times despite my growing discomfort—comfort for her as she could use the least amount of effort to pass the time.
•	Having visited many massage places, this was an unprecedented and unpleasant technique that pulled me out of any chance of relaxation.
Hair spa and scalp treatment
•	The hair spa was the worst part: my scalp was scratched with nails continuously for about 15 minutes as if that was the main “massage,” leaving my scalp feeling hurt rather than relaxed.
•	Conditioner was then used as the main lubricant to massage the scalp, which felt odd, unprofessional, and not at all like a proper head massage.
Environment and professionalism
•	During the shampooing, another staff member opened the treatment room door and started chatting with my therapist while noises from outside kept coming in, breaking any sense of privacy or calm.
•	With so many more professional, and truly relaxing massage places in Da Nang, this visit gave no reason to choose Le Venin Spa again.
(VND 500K for 90-minute body massage; VND150K for 40-minute shampooing w/massage)

reviewList.text:
Must-try experience when visiting Da Nang!

I had an incredible time at Maha Spa. The space is absolutely stunning - peaceful, beautifully decorated, and relaxing from the moment you walk through the door. The staff is so warm, welcoming, and enthusiastic!

reviewList.author: Mai Thị Thùy Dung

reviewList.text:
I visited Maha Spa and overall, it was an okay experience—but not one I’d recommend if you’re truly looking for a relaxing, high-quality massage.
The facilities were one of the biggest downsides. There wasn’t proper indoor shoe storage, and the men’s and women’s changing areas were more like small stalls with partially working lockers. From what my partner experienced, the women’s lockers didn’t even have keys, which made it impossible to securely store belongings. The staff didn’t seem too concerned when this was brought up, which was disappointing.
We booked a 90-minute session that included a herbal hot compress, hot stone treatment, and foot massage. The foot bath portion was decent—they cleaned and lightly massaged our feet well. My massage itself was good, with strong and consistent pressure from the therapist. However, my partner had a much less pleasant experience and felt uncomfortable, especially when the therapist described her as being “difficult,” which was frustrating since we were just trying to relax.
The massage setup also lacked privacy. The beds were all in one large room, separated only by sheer curtains. You could hear therapists whispering and talking to each other or other clients, which really took away from the overall relaxation.
They did serve jasmine tea at the beginning and end, along with a mango pudding dessert. Unfortunately, the pudding tasted sour, so we didn’t eat it.
On a positive note, there was a very cute and friendly cat near the entrance, which was a nice touch.
Overall, while parts of the massage were decent, the lack of proper facilities, privacy, and attentiveness from staff made it hard to fully enjoy the experience. I wouldn’t recommend this place if you’re looking for a truly relaxing spa visit.

reviewList.text: Excellent experience at Maha Spa. Very professional staff, extremely clean and relaxing environment, and honestly one of the best massages I’ve ever had. reviewList.text:
Please don’t come here.

I chose Salon Loc after doing quite a bit of research because they had strong reviews on both Google and Reddit. I went in wanting a C-curl and volume perm to fix two main issues: flatness and frizz. I even prepared a full Pinterest board of reference photos and used ChatGPT to translate exactly what I wanted and what my concerns were.

The service was not cheap — I paid around USD 120. On top of that, they pushed me to add a keratin treatment. I later learned that combining a keratin treatment with a fresh perm is generally not recommended, which already made me question the salon’s understanding of hair health and treatment compatibility.

The experience itself also felt disorganized. The manager who initially consulted me disappeared midway through the appointment and handed me over to someone else without much explanation. The handling throughout was quite rough, and I went through around five separate washes. They also mentioned a haircut and massage as part of the service — the massage was relaxing enough, but it was just a standard shoulder massage and not really anything notable.

What concerned me most was the actual perming process. I kept trying to trust the process, but several things felt off, including them using a hair straightener on my hair while product was still applied.

Unfortunately, the final result speaks for itself. The “volume perm” sections are visibly sticking out in awkward bends, while the C-curl I originally wanted is basically nonexistent. The stylist recommended going for a softer wave instead, but the end result just looks like poorly rebonded hair with random bends underneath. My hair also feels significantly more damaged now, especially near the roots, and salons back home have already told me the damage makes it difficult to safely fix or salvage.

reviewList.text:
I LOVE IT! This place has a 5.0 average review for all the great reasons.
Prompt, pleasant, and professional.
Call to reserve to help them plan if you can, but if you just turn up like we did, they're awesome at magically making it work 👌

We, a group of 4 (females), went in 8:30pm, an hour before close. There were only 2 workers there both occupied. One promptly helped us address all our questions while  finishing up with their clients and sat us down for tea.

Our interactions were super pleasant. We used Google translate and body language to sort every thing out. No confusion on what was included in the menu or pricing. (Cash only though, worth noting.)

Within like 5 mins, all her reinforcements showed up to make sure we all get out of there before 10pm. I got the full body massage. It was thorough and professional. Just the right pressure, and communication. The stone massage was really unique. The hair wash/massage my friends got were also great.

I'd go again if I wasn't leaving the area tomorrow early morning. Don't miss this gem ❤️

(Bonus, the workers there are all super cute! 😎)
reviewList.author: Vivian C

reviewList.text:
I don’t usually get massages but coming from a long trip from Japan I felt I needed one. Friends didn’t have any recommendations.
So I googled whatever is near my hotel and found Nha Minh. Based on the positive reviews, I decided to come.

The rave reviews were spot on. The place was clean, relaxing and my masseuse provided friendly, effective massage. I had the one-hour (I had a meeting to go to afterwards) hot stone package. My exhausted body was restored. This was amazing great value. I loved the service so much I plan to return, as early as next week.

I have to mention Ms. Vuong, manager/owner. When I called to make a reservation, she squeezed me in at a busy time, 5pm. On my way, she followed up to make sure I found the place alright. I was 20 feet from the door and she was there waiting for me. She explained the different offerings, in very clear English. She guided me through what turned out to be the right choice for me. And as I was leaving, she saw me off at the door. Talk about deluxe customer service. This operator genuinely cares for her customers.

Lastly, a reviewer complained about temperature. It was not cold, as claimed. Not even close. Not hot either. They keep the temperature at just the right comfortable level.

Another said staff were talking all the time and it was a noisy environment. Staff talked to each other, yes, but they whispered, and said very little, like 1-2 sentences every 3 minutes or so. The place was pretty much dead quiet. All you can hear is this soft, relaxing piano lounge music. Oh and the sighs of happy customers (one reviewer said she moaned lol).

Then someone said the massage hurt? Of course it might. But you only have to tell your masseuse.  At one point I felt a bit of discomfort but I told my masseuse and immediately she adjusted her technique and pressure and it was alright after that.

This place deserves 6 stars if you ask me. I know I’ll be a regular customer.

reviewList.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ A Wonderful, Professional Couple’s Spa Experience

During our vacation in Da Nang, my wife and I were looking for a relaxing spa day together, and Lounge Spa Danang exceeded our expectations.

The spa has created a welcoming, comfortable, and peaceful atmosphere from the moment you walk through the door. Everyone we interacted with was friendly, professional, and attentive, making us feel completely at ease.

My wife enjoyed a gel manicure and pedicure, a 60-minute foot massage, and a neck and shoulder massage. She left feeling completely refreshed and very happy with the results.

I chose their 90-minute Barbershop Combo, which included a traditional shave with facial massage, eyebrow and nose trimming, fingernail care, ear cleaning, hair wash and blow dry, plus massages for my back, legs, feet, neck, shoulders, and scalp. It was one of the most relaxing grooming experiences I’ve ever had, and the staff never made the service feel rushed.

One thing I’d especially like to mention for fellow international travelers: this is a professional wellness spa offering genuine massage and grooming services. If you’re simply looking for a relaxing, therapeutic spa experience (as we were), you can feel completely comfortable here. There were no awkward moments or uncomfortable upselling—just skilled, professional staff focused on helping us unwind.

The value was outstanding. Including tip, we paid a total of 1,540,000 VND (about US$58.56 / NZ$103.82) for everything:

* My Barbershop Combo: 460,000 VND (about US$17.49 / NZ$32.01)
* My wife’s services: 900,000 VND (about US$34.22 / NZ$60.67)

Considering the quality of the treatments and the amount of time we spent there, we thought the prices were exceptionally reasonable.

One thing to keep in mind: they currently accept cash only, so plan accordingly.

If you’re visiting Da Nang and want a legitimate, relaxing spa experience with excellent service and great value, we highly recommend Lounge Spa Danang. We wouldn’t hesitate to return on our next visit.
reviewList.author: Toyia_Jose Anguiano

reviewList.text:
I’ve been coming to this salon for my manicure more than once, and I absolutely love it every time! 💅

Whenever I’m in Da Nang, this is the only place I go for my manicure. Highly recommend — the best salon in town! 💖

reviewList.text: This is an amazing spa right next to the New Orient Hotel with very good prices and friendly staff. I got my nails done by Quynh, who did a fantastic job with a gel manicure. It was the best manicure I had ever received.  She cleaned my nail beds very thoroughly and shaped my nails exactly how I wanted. She was also very precise and detail-oriented with the character design I wanted. One of my family member’s did the foot combo, which included exfoliation, a foot mask,  and foot massage. They spent a lot of time scrubbing the dry skin and cleaning until the feet were soft and properly moisturized. Their massage services are also very relaxing and stress relieving. My family and I will definitely come back to this spa again. Overall, I would highly recommend this spa and their various services as it is high quality and they work to give you the best experience.
reviewList.author: Anoushka Patel

reviewList.text:
Hello...
I came to Da Nang not for sightseeing or travel, but for a pure vacation to relieve stress and recover my lost physical strength.
As a researcher at Samsung, I have a project in progress, so I have no choice but to spend half of my vacation in the morning and take care of work at the hotel.
This is my first time on vacation abroad, and the destination is the port city of Da Nang, Vietnam.
I considered Japan, but since it has the same climate as Korea, I chose a warm place, and I spend my days going back and forth between restaurants, coffee shops, spas, and hotels.
I also chose a quiet hotel to avoid places with too many people, and I used the hotel spa three times, but the only thing that set it apart was the facilities, and in terms of price, it was not cost-effective at all.
I usually use my laptop for long periods of time, so I prefer spas over alcohol due to turtle neck and shoulder pain.
I use a large spa and many spas once a day, and I found a spa that I often visit, which is the lounge spa that I am introducing to you. The CEO is Korean and has worked for a large company for 20 years and has established himself in Da Nang.
First of all, he is kind and provides pick-up and sanding services, and the facilities are clean, and the employees' work attitude is excellent and kind.
And there are Korean-speaking employees on site, so there is no inconvenience..
I also recommend this spa because it is near the hotel I am staying at, and I have been using it frequently since I happened to stop by.
If you search for the KakaoTalk ID Lounge Spa and add it, you will also receive a discount.
You will receive more discounts when you visit again.
The foot callus removal service is differentiated and the massage is also top-notch.
I plan to get my nails done next time.
Nail care and toenail care too....
I highly recommend it.
Thank you.

reviewList.text: This place was great and I will be back. I get nervous trying new barbershops but have been forced to do so while traveling and this place was great! For more clarification I have wavy hair that is decently long so i need a lot of layers and texture work for my hair to look okay. I also have a modern mullet kind of thing without shaved sides so i made sure that was clear not to use a low guard. My barber knew enough english to understand what i wanted and I showed pictures as well. Nice clean place with great staff that takes care of you. Would recommend to anyone who needs a haircut abroad.
reviewList.author: Garrett Walsh

reviewList.text:
The best barbershop in all of Da Nang. We visited twice. When it comes to my hair and beard I'm extremely picky and demanding, which makes my recommendation for this barber all the more genuine.

I had the fade done on the sides and on the beard. The barber is exceptionally skilled and clearly knows how to work with curly hair. His eye for precision is impressive, he spotted an asymmetry in my haircut immediately and corrected a mistake my regular barber back home in Switzerland had made. The beard line, both on the cheek and around the neck, was perfectly straight, a level of precision that very few barbers back home manage. My beard hair grows in several whorls and different directions, yet he shaved it baby smooth with a straight razor without a single nick. That alone puts him ahead of most.

I got the signature cut, which includes a hair wash and massage. The staff member massaged my scalp, face, shoulders and back, alternating with hot and cold towels throughout. You genuinely feel treated like royalty. I'd take this barber home to Switzerland if I could.

The value for money is unbeatable, and the entire team is consistently polite, friendly and attentive. Highly recommend without hesitation.
reviewList.author: Deniz Avyuzen

reviewList.text:
Hands down the best barbershop experience in Da Nang!
My friend and I came here for a session (haircut, beard, and nose waxing). Even though we arrived a bit late, the staff was incredibly welcoming and accommodated us without any issues.
The level of cleanliness here is unmatched — it feels as exceptionally clean and hygienic as the top-tier salons back in Russia. This was my main priority, and Brothers delivered 100%. The metal tools and clippers are visibly spotless and professionally sterilized. There are many assistants working around the floor, constantly cleaning up, preparing fresh tools, and washing hair, which keeps the environment immaculate.
The barbers are true professionals — very precise, careful, and skilled. Both of our haircuts and grooming turned out perfect. I’m definitely making this my regular spot in Da Nang. Highly recommended!

reviewList.text:
Absolutely incredible experience at Hidden Spa! From the moment we walked in, we felt genuinely welcomed and cared for.

We visited as a family with our 4-year-old son, Levi, and the staff were so kind, patient, and accommodating with him. Travelling with a young child can sometimes be challenging, but they made him feel completely comfortable and helped us relax from start to finish. That level of genuine hospitality is something you don't forget.

I had the Signature Massage, and it was honestly one of the best massages I've ever had. The pressure was perfect, the therapist was highly skilled, and I walked out feeling completely refreshed. After weeks of travelling through different countries, it was exactly what my body needed.

My wife, Michelle, also had a manicure and pedicure, and they did such a beautiful job. The attention to detail was outstanding, and she was absolutely thrilled with the result.

The spa itself is peaceful, spotless, and beautifully designed, creating the perfect atmosphere to unwind. Every member of the team was warm, professional, and genuinely passionate about making sure we had an amazing experience.

If you're in Da Nang, Hidden Spa is an absolute must-visit. It's rare to find a place that combines exceptional treatments with such heartfelt customer service. We'll be recommending Hidden Spa to everyone we know, and we'll definitely be back the next time we're in Vietnam.

Thank you for making our family feel so welcome and for giving us one of the highlights of our trip.I can also make it sound a little more like your natural writing style if you want it to feel even more personal.

reviewList.text:
I absolutely loved my experience here! I have very long, naturally wavy hair, so I'm always nervous about getting it cut. I only like subtle trims, and I've had so many experiences where stylists cut off more than I asked for or add layers that don't blend well. I often wear my hair in braids, so I prefer a clean, blended cut without short pieces sticking out.

From the moment I arrived, she was so kind, gentle, and caring. She really listened to exactly what I wanted and took such great care to trim only the damaged ends while keeping my hair long. The result was exactly what I had hoped for. My hair looks beautiful both naturally wavy and straight, which is so important to me.

The shampoo experience was honestly out of this world! The scalp massage and head scratching were incredibly relaxing, one of the best I've ever had. I also loved that you lie completely flat on a comfortable bed instead of leaning back over a sink with your neck hanging awkwardly. It was so much more comfortable and felt amazing.

They straightened my hair after the cut, and I felt like a queen walking out. I left feeling so cared for, and I'm incredibly grateful to have found a salon I trust with my hair. I'll definitely be coming back even just for the amazing shampoo experience!
reviewList.author: Sofia Wakabayashi

reviewList.text: This was a wonderful experience at the salon. I showed the stylist my inspiration photos, and they did exactly what I asked for, a butterfly layers cut with bangs styled with a blowout. reviewList.text:
Went for a foot massage and a hair spa. Unfortunately it was not the best experience.

The staff were all friendly and polite, and the tea and snacks were nice. However, my masseuse had very long nails and I regularly felt like I was being scratched more than being massaged. At one point during my head spa I was almost tempted to just her to stop.

The place closed at 10pm so my masseuse was clearly eager to get home. She didn’t finish drying my hair (the top of my hair was still wet when we left) and we saw her leave within 2 minutes of us walking out.

Overall, I feel less than relaxed and my scalp is quite sore.

I think if you were to just get a massage, perhaps that would be better.

Spa Lam offers an exceptional experience, from their meticulous full pedicure with exfoliation and gel polish to their delightful treat of tea and coconut biscuits served alongside adorable cats. Great price and quality

reviewList.text:
I recently visited this head spa and had a mixed experience.

The massage was great and very relaxing, and the front desk staff were friendly and helpful.

Unfortunately, the therapist’s nails were quite sharp, which made the hair washing uncomfortable. My ear was scratched during the process, and water repeatedly entered my ear, leaving it feeling blocked afterward. During hair drying, the dryer was held in the same spot for too long, causing discomfort from the heat on my scalp.

Overall, while the massage was enjoyable, the rest of the service felt rushed and lacking attention to detail. I hope these issues can be addressed to improve the customer experience.

I chose the 15 steps hair spa treatment and it includes facial and upper body massage. It was heaven and 100% I recommend this treatment. I paid $9.82, originally priced at $10.34 because if you prebook, you get 5% discount. Not sure how long do they have this promo for though so it's best to ask them first.

I’ve been using this laundry service at 19/21 Quang Trung, Hải Châu, Đà Nẵng 550000, Vietnam, located in the alley next to the Crowne Plaza City Center, and the level of service is truly unbeatable.

I once took my clothes somewhere else and immediately regretted it. That experience made me appreciate even more the standards this place maintains.

What really sets them apart, beyond the quality of the work, is how genuinely friendly and welcoming the staff is. They are always smiling, kind, and easy to talk to, which makes the whole experience pleasant and stress-free. You feel cared for, not rushed.

Clothes always come back perfectly clean, smelling fresh, and neatly folded. Turnaround time is fast, prices are fair, and communication is effortless.

If you’re staying near the city center and want a laundry service you can trust, this is the place. I wouldn’t go anywhere else. Highly recommended.

reviewList.text:
Exceptional service and a wonderful massage experience at MOYA Wellness Spa ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I had a wonderful experience from the moment I walked in until the moment I left. I went for a foot massage and was extremely impressed with both the quality of the massage and the professionalism of the staff.

Everyone was incredibly kind and attentive. The manager speaks English, which made communication very easy. I especially appreciated how much they care about the customer experience—they regularly ask how you’re feeling, whether the pressure is comfortable, and if anything hurts, so they can adjust the massage accordingly.

The little details also made a big difference: a welcome tea when you arrive, and at the end, hot tea and a small snack to finish the experience.

They offer several professional services, and it’s clear that the staff are well-trained and know exactly what they’re doing. Five-star service, excellent attention to detail, and genuine care for the customer.

Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
