reviewList.text:
The spa itself is clean, nicely presented, and staff friendly and easy to communicate with. Initial drinks and snacks nice. Though our massage was I guess last one of the day, starting at 10pm. It may have been this factor that resulted in the whole process feeling rushed, from initial
Drinks, massage itself and after drink. Staff in and out of the room 3/4/5 times to get I believe towels and equipment. All should be brought in at start as sort of made the massage stop/start and less relaxing. The temperature a little hot and my side had LED lights which very bright and I’d suggest removing or turning them down as obviously lighting you want to be relaxing too. The massage itself was more jerky instead of smooth strokes and halfway through I thought perhaps the wrong clipboard with my pre circled choice had been mixed up and instead of an oil relaxing massage, I’d been given so one else’s Thai Massage. The masseuses was polite and attentive but I feel wasn’t quite hitting the right areas, and missed even massaging some parts. Clearly she was trying to do a good job but I felt perhaps lacked the skill and knowledge and maybe needs more practice. It felt like how I’d massage someone (I’m not a masseuse) which wouldn’t be that great. It did feel rushed and when finished I didn’t feel much different as before I walked in. I should have been leaving relaxed but wasn’t. Price and tip is clearly stated at beginning, and like I said the place clean, nice smelling and modern but the main reason you go is for a relaxing massage not the decor and lemongrass scent. Not the worst but not the best and I think if they can improves the staffs skill level and adjust lighting and not rush through pay/massage and hovering over you to finish your post drink, then I’d give another go

reviewList.text:

reviewList.author: Chuan Lik Ng

reviewList.text:
I would like to share some professional feedback regarding my recent experience. I hope the owner can take this seriously and improve the service quality and overall environment for customers.

Firstly, I strongly suggest providing masks for staff to wear while serving customers. During hair washing and body massage services, the staff’s breath blowing directly onto customers’ faces is very uncomfortable. In addition, one staff member appeared to have a flu, cough, and runny nose while serving customers, and unfortunateIly i became sick afterwards as well. For hygiene and customer comfort, staff who are unwell should rest at home or all staffs wear masks while working or consultaion

Secondly, the ventilation and air-conditioning conditions need improvement. The fan was not functioning properly and was blowing directly onto my face, which felt unpleasant. However, when the fan was turned off, the hair washing room became extremely hot because the air conditioner was not working. It would be good for the owner to repair the air conditioner as soon as possible to provide a more comfortable environment for customers.

The hair wash area is quite messy, I also feel the cleanliness and organization of the shop should be improved. Towels were placed on the bedside table without proper arrangement, making it unclear whether they were for hair washing, body massage, hand massage, or foot massage. This creates an unhygienic impression.

In addition, the customer toilet was also being used as a shower area, and the floor inside toilet was constantly wet. This did not feel comfortable or private for customers. I would suggest having a separate shower/toilet area for family use and a separate toilet for customers to maintain professionalism and hygiene standards.

Another important point is the shop’s professional image. There is no proper reception counter, and family members were lying on the leg massage chairs near the main entrance during working hours. Customers can immediately see this when opening the main door, and it gives an unprofessional impression. It would be more appropriate for owners and staff to sit properly at a reception counter during business hours. If anyone wishes to rest, it would be better to do so inside a private room where customers cannot see.

Lastly, there was no drinking water offered to customers before or after the services. This small gesture is part of basic customer hospitality and professionalism.

I hope the owner can consider these suggestions seriously to improve customer experience and maintain better professional standards for the business.

P/s:

I purchased the Intensive Hair Wash service _ duration of 60 minutes.
I noted that face massage was not included, so I requested for face massage.
The staff informed me that there would be an additional charge of 25,000 VND.

I then asked how long the face massage would be. One staff member seemed ready to answer honestly, but another staff member stopped her and quickly replied that it would be 10 minutes.

Based on this information, the total service duration should have been 70 minutes (60 minutes hair wash + 10 minutes face massage). However, the overall service time was still only 60 minutes in total.

I hope the owner can clarify the service timing and ensure transparency with customers regarding additional services and duration. Professional communication and honesty are very important for customer trust and satisfaction.

📌The woman owner *kept pushing additional services* to my mother even after we clearly declined. We had to say “no” many times, which made us feel uncomfortable.

I understand recommending services is part of business, but customers’ decisions should be respected without repeated pressure.

Excellent Value and Professional Service at Salon Hoang Manh Barber (Da Nang)
​I recently visited Salon Hoang Manh Barber in Da Nang and had an outstanding experience! From start to finish, the service was top-notch, and the value for money is unbeatable.
​Overview:
This salon delivers a truly professional barber experience that exceeds expectations, especially given the incredibly affordable prices. It’s the perfect spot for anyone looking for high-quality grooming without breaking the bank.
​The Combo Deal:
I opted for the Haircut, Shampoo, and Facial Wash combo, and I was genuinely surprised by the price—only 120,000 VND! This is an incredible value for the level of care provided.
​Staff and Service:
The staff was exceptionally polite and professional. My barber was attentive, listening carefully to what I wanted for my haircut and executing it with great precision. The shampoo and facial wash added a relaxing touch that made the whole experience feel like a mini-spa session.
My haircut was sharp and exactly what I asked for. The barber paid close attention to detail, ensuring everything was perfectly blended.
​The salon was clean, modern, and had a comfortable, welcoming atmosphere. It’s a great place to unwind.
​I highly recommend Salon Hoang Manh Barber to both locals and tourists. I've found my new go-to place for grooming in Da Nang.
​If you're looking for quality, politeness, and professionalism all in one affordable package, look no further than Salon Hoang Manh Barber.

reviewList.text:
A Terrible Hygiene Nightmare: My 60-Minute Vietnamese Shampoo and Shoulder Massage Experience Note: (Unfortunately, because the lighting inside was extremely dim, it was completely impossible to take any photos as evidence.)
To be honest, the moment I walked up the stairs, I already felt very uneasy—the walls around the staircase were covered in mold.
Once inside, I was asked to lie down on a bed and told to take off my upper body clothes and put on their "beauty vest." I asked where it was, and they pointed to a basket. To be frank, the lighting was extremely dim. There were only two vests in the basket, and I had no idea whether they were clean or dirty. When I asked, the staff just said, "Yes, just put it on." So I put it on and laid down.
The service itself was subpar: they only washed my hair (and since I have long hair, it wasn't a pleasant experience) and briefly touched my neck—it definitely wasn't good. Plus, every time I breathed, I could smell a heavy odor of mold. Afterward, they blow-dried and combed my hair. Honestly, I have curly hair, but they used a large brush to comb it completely straight—which is pretty ridiculous.
Of course, I was extremely unsatisfied. I felt their hygiene environment was deeply problematic. The realization hit me when I took off the vest afterward and was told to "throw it back into that same basket." It hit me like a ton of bricks: Are you kidding me? This meant the vests weren't even being washed—they were just taken off by one customer, placed right back in the basket, and handed directly to the next person. That is completely unacceptable and crossing the line!
I told my husband we must never go back there again—it was just too terrifying. The entire place was kept so dim that you couldn't see anything clearly, but the mold on the walls by the stairwell was undeniable.

They offer two different types of saunas and two ice baths — one at around 4°C for a serious cold plunge and another at 15°C for a more moderate experience. It’s perfect whether you’re experienced or just getting started.

You can also meditate, enjoy healthy meals, and fully unwind in a peaceful environment. The staff are amazing, and a special thank you to Ms. Hien — she is incredibly kind, helpful, and welcoming.

reviewList.text:
Visiting Oneness Retreat in Da Nang was an absolute game-changer for my mind, body, and spirit. This hidden gem is a dedicated sauna and mindfulness wellness center that beautifully blends Japanese-inspired contrast therapy with deep relaxation and healing elements—perfect for anyone seeking true rejuvenation in the heart of Vietnam's coastal city.
The standout feature is the incredible contrast therapy cycle: alternating between the hot saunas (including a powerful far-infrared Oneness Sauna and a serene low-temperature Zen Sauna with soothing blue lights and sacred geometry) and the invigorating ice bath plunges, followed by warm recovery baths. The heat detoxifies and melts away tension, while the cold plunge shocks the system in the best way—boosting energy, reducing inflammation, and leaving you with that euphoric post-session glow. It's the ultimate "totonou" experience, harmonizing body and soul just as promised.
The space is impeccably designed: spacious, spotlessly clean, with ambient music, detox waters on tap, and cozy relaxation areas to unwind between rounds. The staff are warm, knowledgeable, and genuinely passionate about wellness, guiding you gently if you're new to sauna and ice bath rituals.
Whether you're a wellness enthusiast, recovering from travel fatigue, or just needing a reset, Oneness Retreat delivers profound relaxation and vitality. I left feeling lighter, clearer, and more balanced than I have in years. Hands down one of the best wellness spots in Da Nang—I'll be back on my next trip!

places.name: Son Tra Resort & Spa
places.summary: Warm villas with private pools in an informal beachfront resort featuring terrace dining & a spa.

reviewList.text:
Great Value & RELAXING!! This would have been the Resort of its day. Retreat away from the hussle of busy city streetlife into the quiet sanctuary of Son Tra Resort & Spa. These Chalets are huge, spacious for any family or couple & each has its own private swimming pool and outside Spa Baths.  The breakfasts cater to every culture with a wide selection of fresh and cooked. Private white sandy beach out front with water activities available. The restaurant serves food almost around the clock and their is an infinity swimming pool beside the restaurant. If you can look past the age of the property you'll enjoy a restful stay. Its out on a limb.. so you won't be ducking out to grab water etc.... unless you jump on the Resorts free shuttle into Vincom every day. We only stayed 3 days so brought a 7-litre of water with us.
This is a place to completely unwind and chilax, watch loved ones at water play... or enjoy yourself. We enjoyed the lunch and dinner menu which was small but well designed and the value was very reasonable.
reviewList.author: Naomi Glover

reviewList.text:
I had a great stay at Son Tra Resort & Spa. The resort is peaceful, surrounded by beautiful nature, and has a lovely private beach. The room was spacious, clean, and comfortable.

The staff were friendly, helpful, and always ready to assist. The breakfast was delicious with a good variety of options. Overall, it was a relaxing and enjoyable experience. I would definitely recommend this resort and look forward to visiting again.
reviewList.author: Thùy Ngân Lương Thị

reviewList.text: I had a great time at this resort. The place is very beautiful, quiet, and clean.The staff are super friendly. They always smile and help us with everything. Our room was big and very comfortable. It had a nice view of the garden.The food at the restaurant was delicious, especially the breakfast buffet. We also loved swimming in the big pool every afternoon.Everything was perfect. I highly recommend this resort to everyone!
reviewList.author: Loann trann

reviewList.text: Do yourself a favour and stay here in one of their beach front villas. Won't break the bank and breathtaking beach view from rooms. Only a short ride from the main drag, but absolutely magical and we are so grateful to have experienced this.
reviewList.author: Michelle Gardiner

reviewList.text:
I had a wonderful stay at Son Tra Resort & Spa. The resort is located in a peaceful area surrounded by nature, making it a perfect place to relax and escape from the busy city. The view of the ocean was beautiful, especially during sunrise and sunset.
The room was clean, spacious, and well-equipped with everything I needed for a comfortable stay. The staff were friendly, professional, and always willing to help with a smile. I was impressed by their hospitality and attention to detail.
The breakfast offered a good variety of dishes, and the restaurant had a pleasant atmosphere. I also enjoyed walking around the resort and spending time by the beach.
reviewList.author: Ngân Nguyễn Thị Thảo

reviewList.text:
Very disappointing experience and strongly not recommend. We visited this massage shop since it’s just next to our hotel.

The masseur who attended to me seemed inexperienced and lacked basic technique. For a long stretch, she repeatedly applied balm and lightly stroked the same area of my calf without any proper pressure. After I used Google Translate to request more appropriate pressure and to focus on other areas, the massage became uncomfortably forceful instead, showing no understanding of proper technique or pressure points.

Overall, the experience felt unprofessional and poorly executed, as if the staff were not properly trained.

Both masseurs who served my boyfriend and I asked for tips at the end despite the poor service.
reviewList.author: Bobo Lim

reviewList.text:
I chose the relaxing body massage package with natural essential oils, and I must say that the technician's skills are great!
Moderate, rhythmic movements, pressing the right acupuncture points help the body completely relax. Especially the shoulders, neck and back - areas that often get tired from sitting at work - are carefully cared for and massaged very comfortably.
After the massage session, I felt my body feel lighter and my mind more relaxed.

reviewList.text:
Real-life experience with the spa's "new hair removal" technique :))))
It's just my leg, but after the first 10 sessions of full leg shaving, I got folliculitis on the fine hairs on my thighs, and every time I went home, it was red in patches. When I told the spa, they said it was because of my sensitive skin (!?). Okay, fine, it's my skin. I still accepted and bought the next 10 sessions, only half a leg. But they keep saying it's a new cold hair removal technology and requiring weekly visits, even though the hair isn't fine, thin, or sparse at all.

I'm already using a hair removal package at another spa for other areas of my body, and I saw a difference after only the 7th or 8th session. They didn't require weekly visits either, maybe every two weeks or a month. Here, I've had 18 sessions and the hair on my legs is still growing back black. They didn't even do a thorough job, leaving the areas on both sides of my calves untouched, which looks really strange. I'm willing to skip the remaining sessions because I find the hair removal technology terrible. After 10 or almost 20 sessions, my legs look no different than they did before. It's a waste of money.
reviewList.author: Phương Duyên Nguyễn Ngọc

reviewList.text:
DO NOT GO TO THIS BARBERSHOP! I spent 45 days in Vientam and visited 4 different barbershops and here I had the worst experience possible! The guy (I really doubt that he ever studied to become a barber) was in constant hurry while cutting my hair and then shaving my beard. He did a terrible job and I had to literally scream at him so he'll start to shave properly.
The two other staff members, girls, were busy watching videos on YouTube. One of them also did a terrible job while shampooing my hair and trying to do the worst massage I had. It seems that the only thing they care about in this "barbershop" is getting money as quickly as possible without paying any attention to the quality of their services. There are plenty of good and proper barbershops in Danang, do me a favour, AVOID this place! I'm sure any other barbershop will be better!

Very good price . Thank to the team.
Return visit this year Oct 2025 decided to trust the stylist to cut my hair shorter . He did a really great job I am thrilled , I had colour, wash ( with good head massage)  blow dry straighten  . I will be coming back before we end our trip .
